title: Emerging Security Threats in United Nations Peacekeeping Operations: A Quest for Enhanced Peacekeeping Efficiency of Bangladesh Army

detail.title: Emerging Security Threats in United Nations Peacekeeping Operations: A Quest for Enhanced Peacekeeping Efficiency of Bangladesh Army

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Author is currently serving in the Bangladesh Army. He was employed in the United Nations Peacekeeping Operations in the Democratic Republic of Congo and the Central African Republic. In that capacity, while working with different United Nations organs, the author gathered first-hand experience regarding the current context of the countries where the United Nations mission is ongoing. Hence, his research is deeply influenced by his affiliation with the Bangladesh Army and the United Nations.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: The landscape of United Nations Peacekeeping Operations (UNPKO) has undergone profound transformations, with contemporary missions increasingly confronted by asymmetric threats from diverse actors with divergent motivations. Two-thirds of today's peacekeepers operate in conflict-affected environments where the use of force is often unavoidable, yet they remain frequently underprepared and underequipped to meet the evolving security challenges. Bangladesh, a leading troop-contributing country, has earned global recognition for its contributions to peacekeeping, with contingents currently deployed in Mali, the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Sudan. However, the rising incidence of fatalities-particularly from improvised explosive devices (IEDs) and armed group hostilities-underscores the urgent need for adapting peacekeeping modalities and enhancing troop preparedness. This study investigates the training and capacity-building requirements of Bangladeshi contingents to strengthen their effectiveness in the current peacekeeping environment. Employing a mixed-method approach that combines qualitative and quantitative analysis with expert interviews and focused group discussions, the research first examines emerging security threats within UNPKO and then identifies the likely challenges facing Bangladesh Army contingents. Finally, it proposes pragmatic measures to overcome these challenges. The findings support the central hypothesis: enhancing training and organisational capacity building significantly improves the peacekeeping efficiency of the Bangladesh Army in UNPKO. The study concludes by offering actionable recommendations aimed at equipping Bangladeshi peacekeepers with the necessary skills, mindset, and resources to sustain their distinguished role in global peace efforts.

title: Historical (Ourstorical) Meta Analysis in Social Policy Science
affiliations: United International College (UIC)

detail.title: Historical (Ourstorical) Meta Analysis in Social Policy Science
detail.abstract: This article introduces the method of historical (ourstorical) meta-analysis in social policy science. There are many historical (ourstorical) meta-analyses in social policy, as in all other social sciences (including economics). Most recently, impact of monumental proportions was caused by Thomas Piketty’s 2013/2014 publication Capital in the Twenty-First Century. History (ourstory) is most influential and most rich in terms of vital findings in theory-making, welfare state system analysis, policy analysis, and of course social/societal/scientific problem analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了社会政策科学中的历史元分析方法，强调历史分析在社会政策研究中的重要性，并以皮凯蒂的《21世纪资本论》为例说明其影响力。
AI.research_question: 历史元分析方法在社会政策科学中的作用和意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 社会政策科学中存在大量历史元分析研究，这些研究在理论构建、福利国家系统分析、政策分析和社会问题分析中具有重要价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史元分析理论框架，强调历史数据和方法在社会政策研究中的理论基础。
AI.method: 历史元分析方法，通过系统整合和分析历史研究来生成新的理论见解。
AI.findings: 历史分析在社会政策科学中具有巨大影响力，能够产生重要的理论发现，特别是在福利国家系统分析和政策评估方面。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了历史元分析在社会政策科学中的理论地位，强调了历史视角在理论构建中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于历史经验的政策分析工具，有助于更有效地设计和评估社会政策。

title: Bridging Welfare and Work: Assessing Intensive Job Placement for Minimum Income Recipients
affiliations: Centre for Monetary and Financial Studies (CEMFI), Banco de España - Research Department and CEMFI

detail.title: Bridging Welfare and Work: Assessing Intensive Job Placement for Minimum Income Recipients

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We evaluate the effects of a randomized activation program targeting recipients of the Spain’s national Minimum Income Scheme. The intervention combined personalized coaching, job-search assistance, soft-skills training, and, in one treatment arm, also digital-skills workshops. While short-run employment effects were limited, the program significantly reduced the prevalence of informal work and improved participants’ financial resilience. Gains were particularly pronounced among those who received the digital skills component, who reported large improvements in digital task performance. Half a year after receiving the treatment, administrative social security records show emerging positive effects on days worked, contract stability, and full-time employment, especially in the digital-skills group. We also find evidence of a psychological awareness effect: low engagement participants reported lower self-assessed transversal skills, possibly reflecting a shift in self-perception. Our findings highlight the potential of multidimensional, personalized activation strategies to foster formalization and digital inclusion among low income populations.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了西班牙最低收入计划受益人的随机激活项目效果，该项目结合了个性化辅导、求职援助、软技能培训，并在一个实验组中增加了数字技能培训。虽然短期就业效果有限，但项目显著减少了非正规工作，提高了参与者的财务韧性，特别是数字技能组的参与者在数字任务表现上有显著提升。半年后数据显示在就业天数、合同稳定性和全职就业方面出现积极效果。
AI.research_question: 多维个性化激活策略对西班牙最低收入计划受益人的就业正规化、数字包容和财务韧性的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 探索如何通过综合性的激活项目帮助低收入人群实现就业正规化、提升数字技能和增强财务韧性，特别是在数字技能日益重要的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场激活理论、人力资本理论和行为经济学理论，强调个性化干预和多维度支持的重要性。
AI.method: 随机对照实验，将参与者分配到不同处理组（基础激活组和数字技能增强组），使用行政数据、调查问卷和技能评估进行效果测量。
AI.findings: 1) 短期就业效果有限但非正规工作显著减少；2) 数字技能组在数字任务表现上大幅提升；3) 半年后就业天数、合同稳定性和全职就业出现积极效果；4) 存在心理意识效应，低参与度参与者自评横向技能下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了激活理论，强调数字技能在就业正规化中的关键作用，提出了心理意识效应的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了多维个性化激活策略的有效性证据，特别强调了数字技能培训在促进低收入人群就业正规化和数字包容方面的重要价值。

title: Private Highs: Investigating University Overmatch Among Students from Elite Schools
affiliations: University of Surrey, , University College London and University College London - UCL Institute of Education

detail.title: Private Highs: Investigating University Overmatch Among Students from Elite Schools

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Inequality in college attendance is a key driver of intergenerational mobility. We focus upstream to examine how elite high-schools  specifically UK private (feepaying) schools  shape university destinations across the achievement distribution. Using linked-administrative data, we show the main advantage conferred by private schools is not access to elite colleges for their best students, but that lower-achieving students are more likely to overmatch: lower-achieving pupils from private schools enrol in university courses around 15 percentiles higher ranked than similarly qualified state-school students. Examining mechanisms, we show that this overmatch is driven largely by differences in application behaviour.

AI.tldr: 英国私立学校的主要优势不在于让顶尖学生进入精英大学，而在于让成绩较差的学生更可能"过度匹配"——进入比他们成绩水平对应排名高约15个百分位的大学课程，这主要是由申请行为差异驱动的。
AI.research_question: 精英高中（特别是英国私立学校）如何影响不同成绩水平学生的大学去向？
AI.motivation: 大学入学不平等是代际流动性的关键驱动因素，需要从上游（高中阶段）研究私立学校如何塑造大学目的地分布。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育不平等理论、代际流动性理论、学校选择与匹配理论
AI.method: 使用关联行政数据分析私立学校和公立学校学生的大学入学情况
AI.findings: 私立学校的主要优势是让成绩较差的学生更可能过度匹配到排名更高的大学课程（约高15个百分位），而非让顶尖学生进入精英大学
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了私立学校优势的新机制——成绩较差学生的过度匹配，而非传统认为的精英大学准入优势
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解教育不平等提供了新视角，强调了申请行为在教育机会分配中的重要作用

detail.title: Welfare Capitalism Around the World
detail.abstract: This book offers a wide selection of country studies on different types of welfare capitalism from an real-typical point of view. It has been one of the few books ever to cover a great deal of welfare state system from around the world, depicting monumentally different ways in conceiving and developing different models of welfare capitalism, be it Singapore or Hong Kong, New Zealand or Canada, the US or the UK, Switzerland, Germany, France, Denmark or Sweden, Italy or Israel, Korea or Japan, or even countries in Latin America. The authors contributing to this book count to the who is who in welfare state comparison worldwide. Hence, this book is a vital source book, a must read and a must have for every social policy expert, public policy expert, and economist alike.

AI.tldr: 本书从现实典型视角对不同类型的福利资本主义进行了广泛的国别研究，涵盖了全球众多福利国家体系，展示了新加坡、香港、新西兰、加拿大、美国、英国、瑞士、德国、法国、丹麦、瑞典、意大利、以色列、韩国、日本以及拉丁美洲国家在福利资本主义模式上的显著差异。
AI.research_question: 不同国家和地区如何从现实典型视角构建和发展各自的福利资本主义模式？
AI.motivation: 填补福利国家比较研究领域的空白，提供全球范围内福利资本主义模式的全面分析，为政策制定者和学者提供重要参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利资本主义理论、比较福利国家研究、现实典型分析方法
AI.method: 国别比较研究法，通过对多个国家和地区的福利体系进行实证分析和比较
AI.findings: 揭示了全球范围内福利资本主义模式的多样性和差异性，展示了不同国家和地区在福利理念、制度设计和政策实施方面的独特路径
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了福利资本主义的比较研究框架，提供了从现实典型视角分析福利国家的新方法论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、社会政策专家和公共政策专家提供了全球福利体系的全面参考，有助于政策借鉴和国际经验交流

title: What Did We Learn from the North American Income Maintenance Experiments? New Data and Evidence on Household Behavior and Labor Supply

detail.title: What Did We Learn from the North American Income Maintenance Experiments? New Data and Evidence on Household Behavior and Labor Supply

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We re-assess the consequences of a NIT for two-parent families, utilizing hitherto untapped data.The Gary and Seattle experiments fail balancing tests. In New Jersey, Denver and Manitoba weestimate far greater labor supply responses than the current consensus, with remarkableconsistency in point estimates and statistical significance across experiments, genders andcountries. On the other hand, using newly collected data from archival records, we estimatesubstantial increases in happiness, marital satisfaction, household production, and socialactivities in Manitoba. We also reject the contentious finding that the NIT increased maritalseparations in Seattle-Denver, which is driven solely by Seattle.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估负所得税对双亲家庭的影响，发现新泽西、丹佛和马尼托巴实验中劳动力供给响应远高于现有共识，同时马尼托巴实验显示幸福感、婚姻满意度等显著提升，并否定了西雅图-丹佛实验中NIT增加婚姻分离的争议性发现。
AI.research_question: 负所得税对双亲家庭的劳动力供给、幸福感和婚姻稳定性的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 重新评估负所得税的后果，利用先前未使用的数据，检验现有共识的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 负所得税理论、劳动力供给理论、家庭经济学理论
AI.method: 利用加里、西雅图、新泽西、丹佛和马尼托巴实验的未开发数据，进行平衡性检验和统计分析
AI.findings: 1) 加里和西雅图实验未通过平衡性检验；2) 新泽西、丹佛和马尼托巴实验中劳动力供给响应显著高于现有共识；3) 马尼托巴实验显示幸福感、婚姻满意度等显著提升；4) 否定了NIT增加婚姻分离的争议性发现
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了关于负所得税劳动力供给效应的现有共识，提供了更准确的估计
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于负所得税实际效果的更准确证据，有助于设计更有效的收入支持政策

title: Artificial Intelligence as a Complement to Other Innovation Activities and as a Method of Invention
affiliations: Catholic University of the Sacred Heart of Milan - Catholic University of the Sacred Heart of Piacenza, Universita Cattolica del Sacro Cuore and Universita Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Milano

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Complement to Other Innovation Activities and as a Method of Invention

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between Artificial Intelligence (AI) and innovation inputs in Spanish manufacturing firms. While AI is increasingly recognized as a driver of productivity and economic growth, its role in shaping firms’ innovation strategies remains underexplored. Using firm-level data, our analysis focuses on whether AI complements innovation inputs - specifically R&D and Embodied Technological Change (ETC) - and whether AI can be considered as a Method of Invention, able to trigger subsequent innovation investments. Results show a positive association between AI adoption and both internal R&D and ETC, in a static and a dynamic framework. Furtheremore, empirical evidence also highlights heterogeneity, with important peculiarities affecting large vs small firms and high-tech vs low-tech companies. These findings suggest that AI may act as both a complement and a catalyst, depending on firm characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨AI与西班牙制造业企业创新投入的关系，发现AI采用与内部研发和物化技术变革呈正相关，AI既可作为创新投入的补充，也可作为催化剂，效果因企业规模和技术水平而异。
AI.research_question: AI是否补充创新投入（研发和物化技术变革），以及AI是否能被视为一种发明方法，能够引发后续创新投资？
AI.motivation: 虽然AI日益被认为是生产力和经济增长的驱动力，但它在塑造企业创新策略中的作用仍未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI作为创新投入的补充和催化剂的理论框架，关注AI作为发明方法的潜力。
AI.method: 使用企业层面数据，在静态和动态框架下分析AI采用与创新投入的关系。
AI.findings: AI采用与内部研发和物化技术变革呈正相关；大型vs小型企业、高科技vs低科技公司之间存在异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对AI作为创新投入补充和催化剂的理解，提出了AI作为发明方法的概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定AI创新策略提供实证依据，帮助不同类型企业更好地利用AI促进创新。

title: The Immediate and Lasting Effects of Heat Waves On Workers
affiliations: Mercator Research Institute on Global Commons and Climate Change (MCC), Mercator Research Institute on Global Commons and Climate Change (MCC) and Maastricht University

detail.title: The Immediate and Lasting Effects of Heat Waves On Workers

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how prolonged exposure to heat affects the labor force's ability to work in the short and long run. Linking administrative public health insurance records for one-third of the German working-age population to the quasi-experimental occurrence of heat waves, we provide the first comprehensive characterization of the occupation-specific heterogeneity in how heat-induced health damages materialize in decreased labor supply, and its distributional implications. An average hot day increases the number of new sick leave cases, and the effects build with prolonged heat. After seven consecutive days of heat exposure, the impact is roughly three times greater than on the first day. Workers who are already disadvantaged in terms of their income and working conditions are more vulnerable to heat stress. Those who are more flexible in scheduling and adjusting their working hours are less at risk. Our results also reveal a longer-term decrease in labor supply in the years following heat wave exposure, and suggest sustained increases in expenditures for healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将德国三分之一劳动年龄人口的公共健康保险记录与热浪的准实验性发生联系起来，首次全面描述了热致健康损害如何在不同职业中异质地表现为劳动力供给减少及其分配影响。研究发现热天会增加新病假案例，且影响随热暴露时间延长而累积；弱势工人更易受热应激影响；热浪暴露后劳动力供给长期下降，医疗支出持续增加。
AI.research_question: 长期热暴露如何影响劳动力的短期和长期工作能力？
AI.motivation: 理解热应激对劳动力供给的影响及其在不同职业群体中的异质性，以及热暴露的分配影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康经济学和劳动力供给理论，结合环境暴露对健康影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 将德国三分之一劳动年龄人口的行政公共健康保险记录与热浪的准实验性发生联系起来进行分析。
AI.findings: 平均热天增加新病假案例，影响随热暴露时间累积；弱势工人更易受热应激影响；灵活安排工作时间的工人风险较低；热浪暴露后劳动力供给长期下降，医疗支出持续增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次全面描述热致健康损害在不同职业中的异质性表现及其分配影响，扩展了环境暴露对劳动力供给影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于热应激对劳动力市场影响的实证证据，有助于设计针对弱势工人的保护措施和适应性政策。

title: The Bathhouse Game: A Rational Model of Systemic Inefficiency and Institutional Lockin
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Bathhouse Game: A Rational Model of Systemic Inefficiency and Institutional Lockin
detail.abstract:
This paper presents The Bathhouse Game, a formal model that examines how individually rational behavior can generate collective inefficiency and institutional lock-in. The framework integrates microeconomic optimization, psychological inertia, and social feedback to define a new equilibrium form—Inefficient Stable Non-Equilibrium (ISNE)—where every agent behaves optimally within their domain yet the overall system remains stagnated.

The author is an undergraduate student in computer science, not formally trained in economics. This work was developed as part of an ongoing AI-assisted thought experiment exploring how non-institutional actors can construct original theoretical frameworks outside conventional academia. All mathematical modeling and logical design were conceived by the author; GPT tools were employed solely for linguistic formalization and structural clarity, not for idea generation or reasoning.

The paper deliberately contains no empirical case or numerical simulation, because its primary aim is to isolate the structural logic of rational stagnation itself. The model serves as a meta-economic reflection on how optimization, psychological adaptation, and institutional feedback collectively produce systemic inefficiency—and how non-rational interventions might restore social welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了《澡堂游戏》形式模型，探讨个体理性行为如何导致集体低效和制度锁定。该框架整合微观经济优化、心理惯性和社会反馈，定义了新的均衡形式——低效稳定非均衡（ISNE），即每个主体在各自领域行为最优但整体系统停滞。
AI.research_question: 个体理性行为如何导致集体低效和制度锁定？
AI.motivation: 探索非制度行为者如何在传统学术界之外构建原创理论框架，并隔离理性停滞的结构逻辑本身。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合微观经济优化、心理惯性和社会反馈理论，定义低效稳定非均衡（ISNE）概念。
AI.method: 纯粹的理论建模和逻辑设计，无经验案例或数值模拟，专注于结构逻辑分析。
AI.findings: 个体最优行为在特定条件下会导致系统整体停滞，形成低效稳定非均衡状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了低效稳定非均衡（ISNE）的新概念，为理解理性行为与系统效率的关系提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非理性干预如何恢复社会福利提供了理论依据，对制度设计和政策制定具有启示意义。

title: Employer Monopsony Power  Does Not Reduce the Value of a Statistical Life
affiliations: Vanderbilt University, Law School, Law and Economics, Students, Claremont Graduate University - Department of Economic Sciences and Vanderbilt University - Law School

detail.title: Employer Monopsony Power  Does Not Reduce the Value of a Statistical Life

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Although wage rates are lower when employers have monopsony power, we find that the value of a statistical life (VSL) is not reduced when labor markets are more concentrated. Because the estimated VSL is the product of the wage and the wage-risk tradeoff rate, a greater tradeoff rate in highly concentrated U.S. labor markets produces a larger VSL. The general relationship we find is robust with respect to different labor market data. Our results provide the first evidence contradicting policy-related concerns that the VSL is lower in monopsonistic labor markets.

detail.abstract: This article introduces the concept of de facto amnesty as a distinct category within transitional justice. While international law has increasingly restricted de jure amnesties, it has paid less attention to informal or structural practices that foreclose accountability in fact. Such practices, whether extensions of statutory amnesties, tacit political bargains, or systemic enforcement failures, have often been tolerated, and at times legitimized, by international actors. Without a clear framework, they risk being conflated either with impunity or with legitimate reconciliatory measures. The paper proposes a working definition of de facto amnesty and a fivestep diagnostic method for its identification. It then develops a typology through comparative case studies of Lebanon, Cambodia, and Indonesia, each illustrating a distinct modality of non-prosecution. Finally, it advances an "interests of justice" test as a means of distinguishing when de facto amnesties may serve reconciliation and when they merely entrench impunity. By mapping this overlooked phenomenon, the article expands the transitional justice toolbox and sharpens the normative debate over peace, accountability, and reconciliation.

detail.abstract: Traditionally, venture practice judges the visible objects: product, team, market. Yet a snapshot of a startup's state seldom reveals the risks that ripen later. We therefore extend diligence to more time-stable variable: founders' reasoning-the questions they prioritize and resolve at each stage to grow their startup. Analyzing 20,000 real board decisions of 900 startups, we uncover exit-specific questioning patterns that persist across industries. Conditioning on these stable signals improves risk estimation, increases the likelihood of favorable exits, and sharpens revenue-growth ranking, complementing rather than replacing standard VC procedures.

detail.title: A Comparative Law Analysis of the Military Justice Systems of Poland and the United States of America
detail.abstract: Most authors agree that "military justice" does not have a clearly defined normative definition. Nevertheless, the term is anchored in the area of institutionalized activities of a military organization (armed forces) and for this reason it functions in the language of both legal science and military science. The text presents a synthetic outline of the history of military justice in Poland and in the U.S. Underlying the assumptions of the military justice system, such as the need to exercise jurisdiction over military persons, and the need to handle military cases within the framework of separated, common features can be discerned. Due to the fact that problems of the creation and application of military law broadens the scope of normative terminology to include the concept of military justice system, and with it the concept of a military case, this study engages in a broad interpretation of those concepts, and the result yields some surprises. For one, the enforcement of military law runs in a manner separated from the general order in many legal systems. There is no single international standard for military justice: it heavily reflects domestic attitudes about the role of armed forces in society. Even for areas of seeming commonality such as the influence of international human rights law, nations differ in how they apply international standards to the military. Thus, conventional wisdom would hold that military justice systems will vary greatly by country as matters of national prerogative. And yet the common organic features of the military justice system of Poland and the U.S. bear stunning similarities. This, we argue, reveals a common law for military justice, and lays the groundwork for further comparative law studies with a focus on military justice.

detail.abstract: This article specifies Structured Admission as the fifth process of the Black Belt OS, a candidate universal structural law of human organization. While Attraction generates visibility, Conversion secures commitment, and People governs membership cycles, Admission performs the indispensable function of formalizing entry into the collective. Admission consists of six steps and twelve irreducible actions: registration, documentation, preparation, access, ritual, and alignment. These steps transform external commitment into internal membership by crossing a structural threshold. Admission is distinct from Conversion, which secures the decision to join, and from People, which manages the life cycle after entry. Onboarding programs, bureaucratic procedures, or initiation rituals are contextual forms; Admission is the structural law they enact. Three properties define Admission. First, irreducibility: all six steps and twelve actions are necessary, and omission produces dysfunction. Second, sequenced necessity: registration precedes access, preparation precedes alignment, and ritual precedes consolidation. Third, fractal manifestation: Admission recurs across scales, from families adopting members, to firms onboarding employees, to states naturalizing citizens, to digital organizations granting tokens. Theoretically, Admission integrates literatures on onboarding, socialization, rites of passage, and bureaucratic entry into a structural grammar. Practically, it offers a diagnostic tool: dysfunctions such as churn, weak identification, or fragile legitimacy trace to failures in Admission. Structured Admission is the structural law of entry: the grammar by which collectives formalize commitment into membership and secure persistence.

detail.abstract: This article consolidates the Black Belt OS as a candidate universal structural law of human organization, specifying a closed grammar of nine processes, forty-five steps, and ninety-eight irreducible actions. While Articles 1-12 developed macro, micro, and meso specifications, this synthesis positions the catalogue as a complete, testable, and fractal law: the DNA of collective life. The grammar is defined by five properties. Universality: every durable collective exhibits all nine processes. Irreducibility: each step and action is indispensable; omission produces dysfunction. Sequenced necessity: processes and steps follow inevitable order; inversions cause collapse. Fractality: the grammar recurs across scales, from families to firms, states, religions, and digital organizations. Falsifiability: the law can be refuted by discovering a tenth process, a collective persisting without one of the ninety-eight actions, a functional inversion without dysfunction, successful redundancy tests, or inter-coder reliability below κ = 0.80. Methodological protocols are outlined for testing coverage, irreducibility, sequence, fractality, and reliability. Theoretically, the OS provides a structural ontology of organizing, comparable to gravity in physics, DNA in biology, and the periodic table in chemistry. Practically, it offers a diagnostic and predictive grammar for detecting dysfunctions and designing resilient collectives. For the discipline, it advances from mid-range theories toward a structural science of organizing. The unavoidable conclusion: all durable collectives manifest nine processes, forty-five steps, and ninety-eight actions. This grammar is falsifiable but not optional.

title: Beyond the 70% Myth: From Failure Rates to the Question That Matters -Was It Worth It?

detail.title: Beyond the 70% Myth: From Failure Rates to the Question That Matters -Was It Worth It?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract:
For decades, executives have repeated that “seventy percent of transformations fail.” The figure has no empirical origin and survives only through repetition. This paper dismantles that superstition and replaces it with a framework for honest evaluation built on structural absorption and a five-lens “Was It Worth It?” star model.

Drawing on more than two decades of global surveys and academic studies—representing over $1–2 trillion in cumulative transformation spending—and including recent 2025 AI-transformation evidence, it shows that outcomes follow a stable distribution rather than a law of failure: roughly one-third succeed fully, half deliver partial or fragile value, and a minority collapse outright.

The persistence of that pattern points to structural rather than behavioural causes. The classification regime and its star model provide a method to judge whether transformation leaves an organisation stronger or weaker. Case evidence demonstrates that equilibrium, more than magnitude, predicts endurance. The paper concludes by outlining how boards and executives can embed honest appraisal into governance to replace failure rhetoric with disciplined evaluation.

title: Fintech and Digital Transformation of Business in Uzbekistan: A Descriptive Synthesis of The Role of Digital Payments and Ecommerce for SME Development (Revised)

detail.title: Fintech and Digital Transformation of Business in Uzbekistan: A Descriptive Synthesis of The Role of Digital Payments and Ecommerce for SME Development (Revised)
detail.abstract: This paper provides a descriptive synthesis of secondary data and published studies on the digital transformation of Uzbek business, focusing on digital payments and ecommerce as drivers for small and mediumsized enterprise (SME) development. Using official statistics and industry/academic reports, and triangulating regional evidence, the paper explores associations between digital payment adoption, ecommerce growth, and SME performance. The analysis finds a rapid expansion of ecommerce and digital payments in Uzbekistan in recent years and identifies enablers (policy initiatives such as Digital Uzbekistan 2030, improving mobile/internet coverage) and barriers (urban-rural divide, gaps in digital governance and digital literacy). A short regional comparison with other Central Asian (CA) countries shows heterogeneity of ecommerce scale and digital readiness across the region. Findings are reported cautiously as associations (not causal claims) because the study relies on aggregate and secondary sources rather than firmlevel microdata. Policy recommendations focus on targeted digital literacy, incentive schemes for SME digital adoption, rural infrastructure, and regulatory clarifications. Key regional context and evidence are drawn from recent Central Asia-focused studies and the World Bank ECA review.

detail.title: Academic Freedom of Speech

publicationDetails.detailsText: George Mason University Civil Rights Law Journal (forthcoming)

detail.abstract: This Article examines the constitutional foundations, doctrinal developments, and contemporary challenges surrounding academic freedom as a core First Amendment right. It begins by tracing the Supreme Court's recognition of academic freedom as a "special concern of the First Amendment," and shows how this principle has shaped subsequent doctrine. It then analyzes the Ninth Circuit's important clarification in Demers v. Austin, which held that the Garcetti v. Ceballos framework does not apply to academic speech, and contrasts this approach with other circuits that have declined to provide similar protection. The Article explores the jurisprudential tension between institutional authority and individual faculty rights, highlighting how unchecked application of managerial prerogatives can undermine the university's mission as a marketplace of ideas. It also draws on empirical evidence, including recent surveys by the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression (FIRE), demonstrating how faculty self-censorship has reached alarming levels, exceeding those of the McCarthy era, and threatening the integrity of scholarly discourse. The Article further builds on earlier scholarly work arguing that academic freedom is essential not simply for individual expression but for the democratic legitimacy of knowledge production itself. Building from these authorities, it proposes a structured doctrinal test to guide courts in evaluating retaliation claims, one that excludes Garcetti in the academic context, applies Pickering with a presumption favoring faculty, and requires narrow tailoring of institutional justifications. This four-part framework, or test, ensures that universities may govern effectively while safeguarding the intellectual independence of their faculty. Ultimately, the Article argues that protecting academic freedom is vital not only to higher education but to the broader system of free expression that undergirds democratic society. It concludes by urging courts to reaffirm that when academic freedom is compromised, public discourse itself is diminished, and constitutional commitments to free speech are eroded.

detail.abstract: This study examines the culturally effective organization: revisiting the role of employers in workforce development in Kathmandu Valley. detail.abstract: This study interrogates the contemporary elevation of youth leadership as a policy and cultural ideal, arguing that credentialism and global governance rhetoric have displaced the biblical norm of elder-led authority. Anchored in a Sola Scriptura stance, the analysis integrates three lenses-Generational Theory, Foucault's power-knowledge, and a biblical theology of authority-to examine how education-based legitimacy and innovation discourse reconfigure who is deemed fit to lead. Methodologically, it is an integrative review and documentary analysis of peer-reviewed research, official datasets, and institutional programs between 2000 and 2025, bounded ex ante to reduce selection bias and coded for design and risk-of-bias characteristics. Findings indicate that credentialism reallocates status toward younger, formally qualified actors while sidelining tested character, with measurable organizational costs where compliance proxies for competence. Transnational mechanisms-including UN Youth2030 pipelines, WEF Young Global Leaders, and philanthropic fellowships-regularize this shift by selecting, financing, and platforming youth aligned to secular-progressive frames. Concurrent cohort evidence on religiosity and moral permissiveness suggests downstream effects on institutional stability and ethical baselines. By contrast, Scripture locates ordinary governance in mature, plural elder leadership, cautioning against novice elevation (1 Tim 3:6; Job 12:12; Isa 3:4). The paper contributes a theoretically coherent account of how youth-first regimes emerge, why they are spiritually and civically brittle, and what an intergenerational, elder-led corrective entails. Policy and ecclesial implications include pairing youth participation with accountable elder oversight, reforming credential-centric selection, and rebuilding mentoring architectures that join youthful strength to seasoned wisdom.

title: The Theory of Constrained Capacities: The Dragon and the Coffee Cup Metaphor for Institutional and Human Potential in Governance

detail.title: The Theory of Constrained Capacities: The Dragon and the Coffee Cup Metaphor for Institutional and Human Potential in Governance
detail.abstract: Human, institutional, and social capacities are fundamental drivers propelling societies toward sustainable development. The theory of Constrained Capacities, introduced here for the first time by this author, demonstrates how these latent capacities become structurally confined within institutional, cultural, and power-laden contexts, thus being reduced to limited and ineffectual functions. Employing the metaphor of "the dragon and the coffee cup," this article analyzes this condition through philosophical, sociological, and managerial lenses, illustrating how capacities that have the potential to foster emancipation and transformation are diminished into trivial and mechanistic roles. The theoretical foundations of this perspective draw upon the intellectual heritage of eminent philosophers and social scientists, including Amartya Sen, Michel Foucault, Max Weber, and Karl Polanyi, extending to contemporary theories of complexity, social capital, and institutional path dependency. The comparative section examines case studies from developing and developed countries, revealing the consequences of constrained capacities in education, technology, and social capital fields. Finally, operational policy strategies aimed at liberating and equitably distributing capacities are proposed, emphasizing institutional reforms, strengthening transformative leadership, and promoting an innovation culture. This study aspires to establish a theoretical and practical framework for understanding and addressing the challenges inherent to sustainable development.

detail.abstract: This article functions as a complementary shield within the Black Belt OS project. Unlike Articles 1-13, which established and synthesized the grammar of nine processes, forty-five steps, and ninety-eight irreducible actions, this paper introduces no new processes. Instead, it consolidates the blindagem-the final protection-against conceptual, epistemological, and disciplinary critiques. The contribution is defensive and clarifying. First, it reaffirms closure: the 9-45-98 catalogue is complete, irreducible, and non-redundant. Second, it anticipates critiques-tautology, redundancy, cultural relativism, determinism, reductionism, historicity, and non-testability-and shows why each fails under the explicit falsifiability protocol. Third, it positions the OS within the philosophy of science, drawing on Popper (falsifiability), Lakatos (research programs), and Kuhn (paradigms). Fourth, it distinguishes the OS as a supracontextual law from contextual methodologies or models. Finally, it highlights five layers of protection already in place: scientific (preprints, journals), cultural (book, narratives), digital (GitHub registry), institutional (Black Belt Group), and practical (organizational application). The conclusion is unavoidable: the OS is falsifiable but not escapable. It can only be challenged through the defined falsification criteria, not by rhetorical dismissal. Unless disproven by evidence, the Black Belt OS stands as the structural law of collective life.

title: Monitoring the Green Line: Environmental Covenants in Supply Chain Contracts
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Accounting, Arizona State University (ASU) - Finance Department and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Monitoring the Green Line: Environmental Covenants in Supply Chain Contracts
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the determinants and real economic effects of environmental covenants in supply chain contracts, as well as their interaction with public regulatory enforcement. We show that the likelihood of including environmental covenants is positively associated with the expected benefits of managing suppliers' pollution risks and aligning with shareholder preferences for sustainability, and negatively associated with the anticipated costs of monitoring and enforcing compliance. In settings such as high-polluting industries, where both benefits and costs are elevated, whether covenants are adopted ultimately depends on which effect dominates. Using identification strategies based on the close victory of the Democratic Party in elections, we find that stronger public regulatory enforcement reduces the likelihood of covenant adoption, indicating that contractual monitoring and public oversight function as substitutes. Finally, we provide evidence that environmental covenants causally generate tangible improvements in supply chain sustainability, as disciplined suppliers significantly reduce toxic emissions and increase their hiring of environmental specialists.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了供应链合同中环境条款的决定因素和实际经济效应，及其与公共监管执法的互动关系。研究发现环境条款的采用取决于管理供应商污染风险的预期收益与监督成本的权衡，在污染严重行业中取决于哪种效应占主导。更强的公共监管会减少条款采用，表明合同监督与公共监管是替代关系。环境条款能显著改善供应链可持续性，使供应商减少有毒排放并增加环保专家雇佣。
AI.research_question: 供应链合同中环境条款的决定因素是什么？这些条款与公共监管执法如何互动？环境条款对供应链可持续性产生什么实际影响？
AI.motivation: 随着企业面临日益增长的环境责任压力，理解供应链合同中的环境条款如何运作及其与公共监管的关系具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论和制度理论，分析合同监督与公共监管的替代关系，以及环境条款的成本收益权衡机制。
AI.method: 使用民主党在选举中险胜作为识别策略的实证研究方法，分析环境条款采用的决定因素和因果效应。
AI.findings: 1) 环境条款采用取决于管理污染风险的预期收益与监督成本的权衡；2) 更强的公共监管会减少条款采用，表明二者是替代关系；3) 环境条款能显著改善供应链可持续性，减少有毒排放并增加环保专家雇佣。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析供应链环境条款的决定因素，揭示了合同监督与公共监管的替代关系，拓展了企业环境治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计供应链环境治理机制提供指导，为政策制定者理解私人治理与公共监管的互动关系提供实证依据。

detail.abstract: Land use and transportation systems play a vital role in shaping the dynamics of urban areas, with profound implications for sustainability, mobility, and quality of life. Researchers and policymakers have developed various Land Use Transportation Interaction (LUTI) models to understand the intricate relationship between land use and transportation. These models aim to capture the complex interactions between land-use patterns and transportation systems, enabling more informed planning and decisionmaking processes. This study provides a comprehensive review of the applicability of LUTI models, highlighting their strengths, limitations, and potential for addressing contemporary urban challenges. This review encompasses many LUTI models, including microsimulation, spatial econometric, and integrated land-use transport models. It examined the underlying theoretical foundations, data requirements, calibration techniques, and computational aspects. This review identifies key factors influencing the applicability of LUTI models, such as data availability, computational capabilities, and the specific urban context in which they are applied. It explores the challenges faced in integrating land-use and transportation data, incorporating temporal dynamics, and capturing the impacts of policy interventions.

detail.abstract: This article advances the microstructural specification of the Black Belt OS, a candidate universal structural law of human organization. While Article 1 introduced nine essential processes as the macro-level grammar of collective life, this contribution decomposes them into forty-five steps and ninety-eight irreducible actions. These elements form the minimum sufficient catalogue for organizational persistence: the removal or inversion of any action produces dysfunction or collapse. The argument rests on three principles. First, irreducibility: each step and action is distinct, with redundancy eliminated through systematic pruning. Second, sequential necessity: steps follow a 2 strict order, and inversions predictably cause breakdowns (e.g., delivering before validating). Third, fractal manifestation: the 45-98 grammar replicates across scales, from families and startups to armies, states, and digital organizations. The contribution is both theoretical and practical. Theoretically, we show that organizational life is governed not only by nine macro processes but also by a closed micro catalogue that operationalizes the law at the level of action. Practically, the 98 actions provide a diagnostic tool: organizations can locate dysfunction by identifying absent or inverted actions, enabling structural repair rather than symptomatic treatment. Like the periodic table or DNA, the 45-98 catalogue offers the first minimal, testable ontology of organizational action.

detail.abstract: This article specifies Relationships as the ninth process of the Black Belt OS, a candidate universal structural law of human organization. While Attraction creates visibility, Conversion secures commitment, and People govern membership cycles, Relationships ensure the endurance of trust, legitimacy, and connection over time. Without sustained relationships, collectives fragment, lose legitimacy, and collapse. Relationships consist of four steps and ten irreducible actions: continuous communication, monitoring perceptions, offering additional value, and consolidating or expanding bonds. These steps form the universal grammar of sustained connection. Relationships are distinct from Attraction (visibility), from People (internal membership), and from Results (feedback). Stakeholder management, relationship marketing, diplomacy, or reciprocity rituals are contextual practices; Relationships are the structural law they express. Three properties define Relationships. First, irreducibility: omission of any step produces dysfunction, from suspicion without communication to stagnation without consolidation. Second, sequenced necessity: communication precedes monitoring, monitoring precedes added value, and added value precedes consolidation or expansion. Third, fractal manifestation: Relationships recur across scales-from families nurturing ties, to firms sustaining customers, to states cultivating alliances, to digital organizations maintaining communities. Theoretically, Relationships integrate literatures on stakeholders, legitimacy, diplomacy, and reciprocity into a structural ontology of enduring bonds. Practically, they provide a diagnostic tool: dysfunctions such as churn, reputational crises, or breakdowns trace to failures in specific steps. Relationships are the structural law of connection: the grammar by which collectives sustain trust and continuity.

detail.abstract: In this paper we map Venture Capital (VC) investments received by startups operating in the “new” space economy in European countries and North America (US). Relying on an LLM few-shot learning text-based classification methodology performed via the GPT-5 model, we classified 113,273 VC-backed startups from the Pitchbook database, identifying and qualifying 2,336 space startups. Our results show that while VC-backed startups based in European countries are relatively more specialized in the space economy than their US counterparts, they raise lower amounts of capital, receive fewer VC rounds, less quickly, and are backed by smaller syndicates of VCs compared to startups in the US. Our results provide an original overview of the VC funding landscape in this nascent industry and highlight that even if the European space economy startups are attractive to VC investors, they suffer from the relative underdevelopment of the European VC industry compared to the US as startups in other sectors do.

detail.abstract: This article specifies Results as the seventh process of the Black Belt OS, a candidate universal structural law of human organization. While Execution produces value, Results make value visible, measurable, and actionable. They transform action into feedback, enabling learning, adaptation, and persistence. Results consist of five steps and thirteen irreducible actions: defining indicators, monitoring, consolidating, communicating, and realigning. These form the universal grammar of feedback. Results are distinct from Execution, which produces value; from Finance, which records and allocates value; and from Relationships, which sustain bonds. KPIs, dashboards, or cultural narratives are contextual practices; Results are the structural law they express. Three properties define Results. First, irreducibility: omission of any step produces dysfunction, from blindness without indicators to stagnation without realignment. Second, sequenced necessity: indicators precede monitoring, monitoring precedes consolidation, consolidation precedes communication, and communication precedes realignment. Third, fractal manifestation: Results recur across scales-from households tracking budgets to firms analyzing performance, states reporting statistics, and digital organizations broadcasting metrics on-chain. Practically, they provide a diagnostic tool: dysfunctions such as drift, opacity, or fragmentation trace to failures in specific steps. Results are the structural law of feedback: the grammar by which collectives see the invisible, adapt to reality, and endure.

detail.abstract: This article specifies People as the second process of the Black Belt OS, a candidate universal structural law of human organization. While Implementation installs order, People provides the living body of the collective, governing the continuous cycle of recruitment, integration, development, and release. The People process consists of four steps and sixteen irreducible actions that ensure collectives renew, adapt, and sustain membership over time. People is distinct from Structured Admission: Admission formalizes entry, while People manages the internal life cycle after entry. Three properties define the cycle. First, irreducibility: all four steps and sixteen actions are indispensable, and omission produces dysfunction (e.g., failure to integrate leads to attrition; failure to release leads to stagnation). Second, sequenced necessity: the cycle follows an inevitable order-recruitment precedes integration, integration precedes development, and development precedes release. Third, fractal manifestation: the same cycle recurs across scales, from families and teams to corporations, states, and digital organizations. Theoretically, People clarifies the inevitability of membership cycles, integrating insights from human resource management, socialization, and group sociology. Practically, it provides a diagnostic tool: dysfunctions such as churn, disengagement, or stagnation trace to failures in specific steps. By specifying People in detail, this article demonstrates that every durable collective must continually enact this cycle to persist.

detail.abstract: Small businesses constitute over 99% of all firms in the United States and collectively employ almost half of the private sector workforce. Their role extends beyond generating employment and economic output; they also serve as anchors of local communities by providing essential goods and services. Thus, it is critical to understand the business environment in which small businesses operate and to develop policies that enhance their long-term sustainability. However, there is limited research on small business friendliness. To the best of our knowledge, the few existing indices primarily rely on sentiment-based data, focus on a broad, non-local level, or incorporate factors outside the control of local jurisdictions. To address this gap, this study develops an Actionable Small Business Friendliness Index (ASBFI), a tool designed to evaluate the extent to which regional governments support small businesses. Unlike prior measures, ASBFI emphasizes factors that local governments can directly influence through policy actions, grant programs, procurement practice, incentives, partnership, and advocacy efforts. Specifically, the index assesses a host of factors including economic conditions, the regulatory environment, resources and support, workforce quality, and infrastructure. The results will inform evidence-based policy making to improve the small business environment at the local level. This study analyzes 20 counties in South Texas, United States, using ten business-related factors that local governments can influence, such as permitting processes, taxation, access to capital, and infrastructure. Publicly available data were systematically scored across both binary and continuous variables, based on their impact on business and underlying data distribution. These scores were then aggregated to generate a composite index for each county. The ASBFI was validated through a two-step regression that revealed a strong and statistically significant association between the index and small business density (p < 0.05, R² = 0.97). Results primarily rank the counties for their business friendliness, with an interesting finding that stricter permitting processes in top-ranked counties did not appear to hinder the overall small business environment, suggesting that other interacting factors were more salient. However, access to capital and infrastructure remains an area for improvement in several counties. These findings provide policymakers and economic planners with a practical framework for identifying strengths and gaps in the small business environment and implementing targeted improvements. Moreover, the ASBFI offers a transparent, replicable, and accessible tool for local governments to assess their support for small businesses. Future iterations of the index could incorporate additional socioeconomic factors as data availability improves, broadening its applicability and impact.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个可操作的小企业友好度指数（ASBFI），用于评估地方政府对小企业的支持程度。该指数强调地方政府可通过政策直接影响的因素，包括经济条件、监管环境、资源支持、劳动力质量和基础设施。通过对美国南德克萨斯州20个县的分析，验证了该指数与小企业密度之间的显著相关性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个可操作的小企业友好度指数来评估地方政府对小企业的支持程度？
AI.motivation: 小企业占美国企业的99%以上，雇佣了近一半的私营部门劳动力，是当地社区的重要支柱。然而，现有研究对小企业友好度的关注有限，现有指标主要依赖基于情感的数据，或关注非本地层面，或包含地方政府无法控制的因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地方政府政策影响理论，强调地方政府可通过政策行动、资助计划、采购实践、激励措施、合作伙伴关系和倡导努力直接影响小企业环境的因素。
AI.method: 分析美国南德克萨斯州20个县，使用10个地方政府可影响的商业相关因素（如许可流程、税收、资本获取和基础设施）。基于公开数据系统评分，生成每个县的综合指数，并通过两步回归验证指数有效性。
AI.findings: ASBFI与小企业密度之间存在强且统计显著的相关性（p < 0.05，R² = 0.97）。排名靠前的县虽然许可流程更严格，但并未阻碍整体小企业环境，表明其他交互因素更为重要。资本获取和基础设施仍是多个县需要改进的领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个强调地方政府可直接影响因素的小企业友好度评估框架，填补了现有研究的空白，为小企业环境评估提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和经济规划者提供了识别小企业环境优势和差距的实用框架，帮助实施有针对性的改进措施。ASBFI是一个透明、可复制且易于使用的工具，可供地方政府评估对小企业的支持程度。

detail.abstract: Giao-ism", an internet meme, have emerged as a striking example of how internet culture transforms a single exclamation into a full-fledged symbolic system. Originating from the viral performances of a grassroot influencer the phrase "giao" transcended its initial comedic context to become a language marker, a repertoire of gestures, and a playful form of pseudo-scholarship. Its circulation across platforms demonstrates the remarkable speed with which parody and irony accumulate cultural weight. Studying giao-ism reveals how grassroots communities create meaning from absurdity, showing that even trivial elements can crystallize into frameworks of identity, cohesion, and enduring cultural resonance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了"giaois"这一网络迷因如何从简单的感叹词演变为完整的符号系统，揭示了草根社区如何从荒诞中创造意义，以及网络文化如何快速积累文化重量。

title: From KYC to KYCB: Moving Towards Behavioral Compliance in Digital Finance

detail.title: From KYC to KYCB: Moving Towards Behavioral Compliance in Digital Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently, without any commercial, financial, or personal relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or personally identifiable information. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or funding. It was self-initiated and conducted under Sandscript AI as part of ongoing work in compliance innovation and digital finance research.

detail.abstract: Traditional Know Your Customer (KYC) models tend to focus on verification of identity at specific timestamps, but are not as adept at observing slowly changing or sophisticated patterns of payment fraud that arise post-onboarding. In this work, we propose the KYCB framework as an adjunct layer to conventional KYC and transaction monitoring mechanisms. KYCB focuses on near-real-time analysis of behavioral signals-transaction flows, device fingerprints, biometrics, and relational graphs-to uncover anomalies and increase compliance durability. This paper presents the conceptual model, followed by a literature review; benefits, challenges in implementation, and future directions for policy and research are discussed.

AI.tldr: 提出了KYCB框架作为传统KYC和交易监控机制的补充层，通过分析行为信号来检测支付欺诈模式

AI.method: 提出KYCB概念模型，分析交易流、设备指纹、生物特征和关系图等行为信号

AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了KYC理论框架，引入了行为分析维度，为支付欺诈检测提供了新的理论视角

title: The Urban Learning Premium - Evidence from Peru
affiliations: University of Sussex - Department of Economics, University of Sussex and

detail.title: The Urban Learning Premium - Evidence from Peru

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the urban learning and schooling premium in Peru using two approaches: 1) estimating the effect of local population density on pupils value-added in learning between grades two to eight, 2) quasi-experimental Census estimations on the effects of the duration of urban exposure in childhood on school attainment. Unconditional estimates show that a ten-fold increase in population density is associated with around 0.13 standard deviations higher value-added in learning. Conditional estimates suggest that this association is driven largely by sorting, captured mainly by household socio-economic status, and local area factors, reflecting agglomeration benefits. School resources, in turn, are unimportant. Finally, a higher population density also correlates with unobserved factors that can harm learning. The quasi-experimental estimations confirm a positive relationship between urban exposure and educational outcomes: a longer period of urban education leads to higher educational attainment and a higher likelihood of enrolment in the correct grade for age.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两种方法研究秘鲁的城市学习与教育溢价：1）分析人口密度对2-8年级学生学习增值的影响；2）使用准实验方法评估童年期城市暴露时间对学业成就的影响。研究发现人口密度增加与学习增值正相关，但主要由家庭社会经济地位排序和集聚效应驱动，学校资源作用不大。同时，城市暴露时间越长，教育成就越高。
AI.research_question: 秘鲁的城市学习与教育溢价是如何形成的？人口密度和城市暴露时间如何影响学生的学习增值和学业成就？
AI.motivation: 理解城市环境中教育优势的来源，探究人口密度、家庭背景、学校资源和集聚效应对教育成果的相对重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市经济学中的集聚效应理论、教育生产函数理论、人力资本积累理论。
AI.method: 1）估计人口密度对2-8年级学生学习增值的影响；2）使用准实验方法分析童年期城市暴露时间对学业成就的影响。
AI.findings: 人口密度增加10倍与学习增值提高0.13个标准差相关；这种关联主要由家庭社会经济地位排序和集聚效应驱动，学校资源作用不显著；更长的城市教育时间导致更高的教育成就和适龄入学率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了城市教育优势的驱动机制，强调了排序效应和集聚效应的重要性，挑战了学校资源决定论的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定提供实证依据，建议关注城乡教育差距的结构性因素，而非单纯增加学校资源投入。

title: International Student Migration: Did Brexit Close the Door to EU Students?
affiliations: University of Bath, University of Antwerp, University of Antwerp and Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, School of Business and Economics

detail.title: International Student Migration: Did Brexit Close the Door to EU Students?

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the effect of the Brexit process on international student migration from the European Union (EU) to the United Kingdom (UK). Using administrative data on higher education students in the UK, we employ a dynamic and a synthetic difference-in-differences estimator to compare EU to non-EU students. We show that the Brexit referendum itself and the introduction of visa requirements did not affect EU student migration. However, the introduction of higher tuition fees led to a large reduction in EU student applications to UK universities and colleges, and, subsequently, a decline in place offers, student acceptances, and enrolments. The effect ranges from 48% to 64%. Our findings suggest that increased tuition fees acted as a deterrent for EU students wanting to study in the UK.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了英国脱欧过程对欧盟学生赴英留学的影响，发现脱欧公投本身和签证要求变化没有显著影响，但学费上涨导致欧盟学生申请减少48%-64%，成为主要阻碍因素。

AI.method: 使用英国高等教育学生行政数据，采用动态和合成双重差分法比较欧盟与非欧盟学生。
AI.findings: 脱欧公投和签证要求变化对欧盟学生迁移无显著影响，但学费上涨导致欧盟学生申请减少48%-64%，并影响录取和入学人数。

title: Tolls on Entrepreneurs from Capital Market Distortions: Evidence from IPO Locational Choices
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University, Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Finance, Nanyang Technological University (NTU) - Division of Economics and South China University of Technology

detail.title: Tolls on Entrepreneurs from Capital Market Distortions: Evidence from IPO Locational Choices
detail.abstract:
Capital controls and other policy distortions in the capital market are costly to entrepreneurs. We propose a structural estimation approach to quantify the effect using IPO locational choices. We estimate the willingness-to-pay to bypass these distortions by the Chinese entrepreneurs with overseas listed firms to be a haircut in firm value by 50-60%. We infer that the welfare for the entrepreneurs could rise by 22% from the relevant capital market reforms.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析中国企业在海外上市的选择行为，量化了资本管制对企业家的成本。研究发现企业家愿意承受50-60%的企业价值折价来规避资本管制，资本市场改革可使企业家福利提升22%。

title: Finance -Resource Grammar: The Supracontextual Laws of Recording, Organizing, and Allocating Value

detail.title: Finance -Resource Grammar: The Supracontextual Laws of Recording, Organizing, and Allocating Value

declarations.funderStatement: The work was developed and financed by a research project by the company Black Belt Tráfego, which is part of the still conceptual structure of the Black Belt Group

publicationDetails.detailsText: Part 11 of the Black Belt OS™ Collectanea (14 articles) September 2025 | https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17153825 [undefined]

detail.abstract: This article specifies Finance as the eighth process of the Black Belt OS, a candidate universal structural law of human organization. While Execution produces value and Results make it visible, Finance ensures that resources are recorded, organized, and allocated to sustain persistence. Without Finance, collectives drift into scarcity, imbalance, or collapse. Finance consists of five steps and thirteen irreducible actions: recording flows, organizing accounts, fulfilling obligations, analyzing balances, and allocating resources. These steps form the universal grammar of resource management. Finance is distinct from Results, which monitor performance; from Execution, which produces value; and from Relationships, which sustain 2 bonds. Accounting systems, budgets, taxes, or barter exchanges are contextual practices; Finance is the structural law they express. Three properties define Finance. First, irreducibility: omission of any step generates dysfunction, from blindness without recording to collapse without allocation. Second, sequenced necessity: flows must be recorded before organization, organization before obligations, obligations before analysis, and analysis before allocation. Third, fractal manifestation: Finance recurs across scales-from families budgeting groceries, to firms balancing ledgers, to states taxing citizens, to digital organizations distributing tokens. Theoretically, Finance integrates accounting, economics, administration, and anthropology into a structural ontology of resources. Practically, it provides a diagnostic tool: dysfunctions such as insolvency or imbalance trace to failures in specific steps. Finance is the structural law of resource metabolism: the grammar by which collectives sustain energy, distribute value, and persist.

title: Relative Income and Gender Norms: Evidence from Latin America
affiliations: Inter-American Development Bank, Georgetown University and Vanderbilt University

detail.title: Relative Income and Gender Norms: Evidence from Latin America

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using data from over 500,000 dual-earner households in Mexico, we provide evidence of discontinuities in the distribution of relative income within households in Latin America. Similar to the situation in high-income countries, we observe a sharp drop at the 50% threshold, i.e., where the wife earns more than the husband, but the discontinuity is up to five times larger and has increased over time. These patterns are robust to the exclusion of equal earners, self-employed individuals, and couples in the same occupation/industry. Discontinuities persist across subgroups, including couples with or without children, those with married or unmarried partners, and those with older wives or female household heads. We also find comparable discontinuities in Brazil and Panama, as well as among some same-sex couples. Moreover, women who are primary earners continue to supply more nonmarket labor than do their male partners, although the gap is narrower than in households where the woman is the secondary earner.

AI.tldr: 基于墨西哥50万双职工家庭数据，研究发现拉丁美洲家庭收入分配在妻子收入超过丈夫的50%阈值处存在显著不连续性，这种不连续性是高收入国家的5倍且随时间增加。该模式在不同子群体中持续存在，且女性主要收入者仍承担更多非市场劳动。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲双职工家庭中相对收入分布是否存在不连续性？这种不连续性在不同群体中的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 了解拉丁美洲地区家庭内部收入分配模式，特别是妻子收入超过丈夫时的行为反应，填补该地区相关研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭经济学和性别角色理论，探讨收入分配对家庭内部劳动分工的影响。
AI.method: 使用墨西哥50万双职工家庭数据，采用断点回归分析，考察相对收入分布在50%阈值处的不连续性。
AI.findings: 发现妻子收入超过丈夫的50%阈值处存在显著不连续性，这种不连续性是高收入国家的5倍且随时间增加；女性主要收入者仍承担更多非市场劳动。

title: Supervising Failing Banks
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond, Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Supervising Failing Banks
detail.abstract:
This paper studies the role of banking supervision in anticipating, monitoring, and disciplining failing banks. We document that supervisors anticipate most bank failures with a high degree of accuracy. Supervisors play an important role in requiring troubled banks to recognize losses, taking enforcement actions, and ultimately closing failing banks. To establish causality, we exploit exogenous variation in supervisory strictness during the Global Financial Crisis. Stricter supervision leads to more loss recognition, reduced dividend payouts, and an increase in the likelihood and speed of closure. Increased strictness entails a trade-off between a lower resolution cost to the FDIC and reduced credit.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨银行监管在预测、监控和处置失败银行中的作用。研究发现监管者能高度准确地预测大多数银行失败，并通过要求亏损确认、采取执法行动和关闭失败银行来发挥重要作用。利用全球金融危机期间监管严格度的外生变化，研究证实更严格的监管会导致更多亏损确认、减少股息支付，并提高关闭的可能性和速度，但需要在降低FDIC处置成本与减少信贷之间权衡。
AI.research_question: 银行监管在预测、监控和处置失败银行中扮演什么角色？更严格的监管如何影响银行的损失确认、股息支付和关闭决策？
AI.motivation: 理解银行监管在银行失败过程中的实际作用，特别是监管严格度对银行行为和处置结果的影响，对于完善银行监管政策和降低系统性风险具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行监管理论、银行失败预测理论和监管干预理论，研究监管严格度对银行行为和市场结果的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用全球金融危机期间监管严格度的外生变化作为自然实验，建立因果识别策略，分析监管严格度对银行损失确认、股息支付和关闭决策的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 监管者能高度准确地预测大多数银行失败；2) 更严格的监管导致更多损失确认、减少股息支付；3) 提高关闭失败银行的可能性和速度；4) 严格的监管在降低FDIC处置成本与减少信贷之间存在权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 为银行监管有效性提供了因果证据，深化了对监管严格度影响银行行为机制的理解，丰富了银行失败处置理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构优化监管策略提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者在监管严格度与信贷供给之间做出更明智的权衡决策。

title: What is the Best Response? Examining the Impact of Police and Their Alternatives
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, Duke University, Duke University, Duke University and University of Michigan

detail.title: What is the Best Response? Examining the Impact of Police and Their Alternatives
detail.abstract:
Cities across America are adopting civilian crisis response programs as alternatives to traditional policing, yet causal evidence on their impact and cost-effectiveness is scarce. This paper evaluates Durham, North Carolina’s HEART program, which diverts nonviolent 911 calls from police. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that HEART reduces crime reports, arrests, and response times—primarily through civilian phone and in-person responses, rather than police-civilian co-responses. The program increases future 911 calls, which suggests it fosters public trust. Based on an original contingent valuation survey and applying the marginal value of public funds framework, we conclude that HEART is a fiscally self-sustainable intervention.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市的HEART项目，该项目将非暴力的911报警电话从警方转由平民响应。研究发现该项目通过平民电话和现场响应（而非警民联合响应）减少了犯罪报告、逮捕和响应时间，同时增加了未来的911报警电话，表明增强了公众信任。基于边际公共资金价值框架，该项目被证明是财政自给自足的干预措施。
AI.research_question: 平民危机响应项目（如HEART项目）对犯罪报告、逮捕、响应时间和公众信任的影响及其成本效益如何？
AI.motivation: 美国各地城市正在采用平民危机响应项目作为传统警务的替代方案，但关于其影响和成本效益的因果证据稀缺。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边际公共资金价值框架、公共信任理论、警务替代方案理论
AI.method: 双重差分设计、原始条件价值评估调查
AI.findings: HEART项目减少了犯罪报告、逮捕和响应时间（主要通过平民电话和现场响应），增加了未来911报警电话（表明增强了公众信任）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为平民危机响应项目的有效性提供了因果证据，验证了公共信任理论在警务替代方案中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明HEART项目是财政自给自足的干预措施，为其他城市实施类似项目提供了实证依据和政策参考。

title: The Impacts of Romantic Relationships with the Boss
affiliations: University of British Columbia Okanagan, Aalto University and University of Southern California

detail.title: The Impacts of Romantic Relationships with the Boss
detail.abstract:
Romantic relationships in the workplace are common, but those between managers and subordinates have increasingly drawn scrutiny. Using administrative data on the universe of cohabiting couples in Finland, we examine the career implications of starting or ending a personal relationship with a workplace manager and the spillovers of these relationships on the broader workforce. An event study design reveals that entering a relationship with a manager increases the subordinate's earnings by 6%, but breaking up triggers an abrupt 18% earnings decline. We also find that these relationships generate spillovers: retention of other workers declines by six percentage points, with effects concentrated in workplaces where subordinates experience greater earnings gains. Our findings highlight both the private benefits and organizational costs of hierarchical workplace relationships.

title: In Pursuit of the Green Transition — Electricity at Any Cost?
affiliations: Chalmers University of Technology, Research Institute of Industrial Economics (IFN) and Södertörn University

detail.title: In Pursuit of the Green Transition — Electricity at Any Cost?

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine EU and UK plans for achieving a fossil-free energy system by 2050, centered on massive electrification and large-scale deployment of wind and solar power. Using empirical trends, cost analyses, and system-function assessments, we argue that current strategies underestimate real economic, technical, and social challenges. Three scenarios for meeting 2050 electricity demand are compared: full reliance on renewables; a 50/50 split between wind-solar and nuclear; predominantly nuclear. Evidence shows that higher shares of weather-dependent generation correlate with higher electricity pric-es, greater volatility, and increased system integration costs. High renewable shares require extensive backup, storage, and grid reinforcement, raising complexity and environmental impacts. Overlooked costs are highlighted: reduced capacity value, transmission expansion, balancing services, and so-cial externalities. Sustainability must encompass environmental, economic, and social dimensions. A technologically diverse, dispatchable-power-based strategyespecially with expanded nuclear power offers a more robust, cost-effective, and socially acceptable pathway to climate neutrality than a predominant reliance on intermittent renewables.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟和英国2050年实现无化石能源系统的计划，认为当前过度依赖风能和太阳能的策略低估了经济、技术和社会挑战。通过比较三种情景（全可再生能源、风光与核电各半、核电为主），发现高比例风光发电会导致电价更高、波动性更大、系统整合成本更高。建议采用技术多样化、以可调度电力为基础的策略，特别是扩大核电，作为更稳健、经济和社会可接受的碳中和路径。
AI.research_question: 欧盟和英国2050年实现无化石能源系统的计划是否低估了依赖大规模风能和太阳能的经济、技术和社会挑战？

AI.theoretical_framework: 能源系统转型理论、成本效益分析框架、可持续性三维度（环境、经济、社会）理论
