title: Measuring What Matters: Why Italy May Be in Better Fiscal Shape than the US
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Boston University - Department of Economics,  and Boston University

detail.title: Measuring What Matters: Why Italy May Be in Better Fiscal Shape than the US
detail.abstract:
This study uses fiscal gap accounting (FGA) and generational accounting (GA) to compare US and Italian fiscal solvency. FGA and GA incorporate all government outlays and receipts, whether put on or kept off the books. FGA measures, in the form of reduced net outlays, the constant share of each future year’s GDP needed to balance the government’s intertemporal budget. GA calculates the lifetime net tax rate – lifetime taxes divided by lifetime labor earnings -- facing future generations if current generations pay nothing more, on net, than current policy mandates. Deficit accounting suggests that Italy’s 135 percent debt-to-GDP ratio places it in worse fiscal shape than the US with its 123 percent ratio. But on a fiscal-gap basis, Italy appears in far better shape regardless of the discount rate used. Based on the theoretically appropriate rate – the average real return to national wealth, the U.S. fiscal gap is 7.4%. Italy’s is 4.0%. These requisite solvency adjustments are far larger if delayed or if the UN’s more pessimistic demographic projections prevail. Neither country can expect future generations, on their own, to cover their government’s red ink. Doing so requires levying lifetime net tax rates, in each country, that exceed 100%.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用财政缺口会计和代际会计方法比较美国和意大利的财政偿付能力。研究发现，尽管意大利的债务/GDP比率高于美国，但从财政缺口角度看，意大利的财政状况反而更好。美国财政缺口为7.4%，意大利为4.0%。两国都无法依靠未来世代单独承担政府赤字，需要征收超过100%的终身净税率。
AI.research_question: 美国和意大利的财政偿付能力比较：哪个国家面临更大的财政可持续性挑战？
AI.motivation: 传统赤字会计方法可能无法准确反映国家的长期财政可持续性，需要采用更全面的财政缺口和代际会计方法来评估财政偿付能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政缺口会计和代际会计理论框架，考虑了所有政府收支项目（无论是否在账面上），评估政府跨期预算平衡和代际税收负担。
AI.method: 使用财政缺口会计和代际会计方法，分析美国和意大利的财政数据，采用不同的贴现率和人口预测情景。
AI.findings: 1. 意大利债务/GDP比率135%高于美国123%，但财政缺口显示意大利状况更好；2. 美国财政缺口7.4%，意大利4.0%；3. 延迟调整或使用联合国悲观人口预测会显著增加所需调整规模；4. 两国都需要征收超过100%的终身净税率才能平衡财政。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了财政缺口会计和代际会计在比较国家财政偿付能力方面的应用，挑战了传统债务/GDP比率作为财政健康指标的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的财政可持续性评估工具，强调了及时财政调整的重要性，并揭示了代际公平问题。

title: Asset Returns as Carbon Taxes
affiliations: Stanford University, Stanford University, Stanford University and Stanford University

detail.title: Asset Returns as Carbon Taxes
detail.abstract:
In frictionless financial markets, a carbon tax on energy users provides the same incentives as a replicating asset price schedule that depends on emissions. In particular, the replicating rate of return on a firm increases linearly in scope 1 emissions relative to enterprise value. We use this result to interpret pollution premia measured by recent empirical studies and conclude that markets currently provide only modest incentives. Replicating a serious carbon tax requires high returns in the right tail of the emission intensity distribution. With heterogeneous investors, such returns are not sustainable unless essentially everyone perceives large nonpecuniary costs from holding dirty capital. Substantial emission reductions can be achieved, however, when even a small share of investors perceive nonpecuniary benefits from owning clean electricity capital.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 在无摩擦金融市场中，碳税与基于排放的资产价格安排提供相同激励。研究发现市场目前仅提供有限减排激励，复制有效碳税需要高排放强度企业提供高回报，这只有在大多数投资者认为持有污染资产存在巨大非金钱成本时才可持续。但即使小部分投资者偏好清洁能源资产，也能实现显著减排。
AI.research_question: 金融市场如何通过资产定价机制为碳排放提供激励，以及这种机制与碳税政策的等效性如何？
AI.motivation: 理解金融市场在应对气候变化中的作用，探讨资产定价机制能否有效替代碳税政策来激励减排。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无摩擦金融市场理论、资产定价理论、碳定价机制理论
AI.method: 理论模型分析，通过构建碳税与资产价格安排的等效关系，分析市场激励机制的效率
AI.findings: 1) 碳税与基于排放的资产价格安排具有等效激励效果；2) 当前市场仅提供有限的减排激励；3) 复制有效碳税需要高排放企业提供高回报；4) 小部分投资者对清洁资产的偏好即可实现显著减排
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了碳税与金融市场资产定价机制的等效理论框架，揭示了市场激励减排的机制和条件
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过金融市场机制激励减排的新思路，帮助投资者理解碳排放对资产回报的影响

title: What is More Important for Subjective Longevity Expectations: Perceived Health or Income?
affiliations: Arizona State University (ASU) - Economics Department

detail.title: What is More Important for Subjective Longevity Expectations: Perceived Health or Income?
detail.abstract:
This research considers the role of income for subjective longevity assessments. The analysis uses the 2022 Survey of Consumer Finances. My findings indicate that treating subjective health and longevity assessments as jointly determined is important to understanding the role of income for both judgments. Income has a positive effect on health judgments and does not have a statistically significant effect on subjective longevity when health is rated as excellent or good. Surveys framing the longevity question in direct or probabilistic terms may have complementary roles in estimating subjective longevity.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨收入对主观寿命评估的影响，发现将主观健康和寿命评估视为联合决定因素对于理解收入在两者判断中的作用很重要。收入对健康判断有正向影响，但在健康评级为优秀或良好时，对主观寿命没有显著统计影响。
AI.research_question: 收入在主观寿命评估中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解收入如何影响个体对自身寿命的主观判断，以及这种判断与健康评估的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主观健康和寿命评估的联合决定理论框架
AI.method: 使用2022年消费者金融调查数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 收入对健康判断有正向影响；当健康评级为优秀或良好时，收入对主观寿命没有显著统计影响；不同提问框架的寿命问题在估计主观寿命方面具有互补作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了主观健康和寿命评估应被视为联合决定因素的理论观点，深化了对收入影响主观判断机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为调查设计提供了指导，建议在评估主观寿命时采用直接和概率性提问框架相结合的方法。

title: Big Beautiful Numbers: The Impact of Governmental Data on Firms' Valuations
affiliations: University of Arizona - Department of Economics

detail.title: Big Beautiful Numbers: The Impact of Governmental Data on Firms' Valuations
detail.abstract:
I use the prices of financial options to study the value of macroeconomic data produced by the Bureau of Labor Statistics and the Bureau of Economic Analysis. I show that options traders expect several data products to contain information relevant to valuations of firms throughout the economy. The most affected firms tend to be larger and more capital-intensive. Traders especially anticipate data releases in more recent years and in periods of high uncertainty about economic policy. Traders expect more relevant information from U.S. government data products than from Federal Reserve policy statements and minutes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文使用金融期权价格研究美国劳工统计局和经济分析局发布的宏观经济数据的价值，发现期权交易者预期这些数据产品包含对整个经济中企业估值相关的信息，受影响最大的企业通常规模更大、资本密集度更高。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济数据产品对金融市场参与者的信息价值如何？
AI.motivation: 评估政府发布的宏观经济数据在金融市场中的实际价值，了解交易者如何利用这些数据进行决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和金融市场效率理论，分析数据发布对资产定价的影响。
AI.method: 使用金融期权价格数据，分析不同宏观经济数据发布前后的价格变化。
AI.findings: 1) 期权交易者预期多个数据产品包含企业估值相关信息；2) 受影响最大的企业规模更大、资本密集度更高；3) 近年来和高经济政策不确定性时期，交易者对数据发布更敏感；4) 美国政府数据产品比美联储政策声明和会议纪要包含更多相关信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信息经济学提供了实证证据，展示了宏观经济数据在金融市场中的具体价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者了解数据发布的市场影响，为投资者提供数据价值评估的参考。

title: Repeated Matching Games An Empirical Framework
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, Abu Dhabi, University of Michigan at Ann Arbor and New York University (NYU)

detail.title: Repeated Matching Games An Empirical Framework
detail.abstract:
We introduce a model of dynamic matching with transferable utility, extending the static model of Shapley and Shubik (1971). Forward-looking agents have individual states that evolve with current matches. Each period, a matching market with market-clearing prices takes place. We prove the existence of an equilibrium with time-varying distributions of agent types and show it is the solution to a social planner’s problem. We also prove that a stationary equilibrium exists. We introduce econometric shocks to account for unobserved heterogeneity in match formation. We propose two algorithms to compute a stationary equilibrium. We adapt both algorithms for estimation. We estimate a model of accumulation of job-specific human capital using data on Swedish engineers.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Shapley和Shubik(1971)的静态匹配模型，提出了一个具有可转移效用的动态匹配模型。前瞻性代理人的个体状态随当前匹配而演变，每期进行具有市场出清价格的匹配市场。证明了时变代理类型分布均衡的存在性，并表明这是社会规划者问题的解。还证明了平稳均衡的存在性，引入计量经济学冲击来处理匹配形成中的未观测异质性。提出了两种计算平稳均衡的算法，并调整用于估计。使用瑞典工程师数据估计了工作特定人力资本积累模型。
AI.research_question: 如何在动态环境中建立具有可转移效用的匹配模型？动态匹配均衡的存在性和性质是什么？如何估计这类模型？
AI.motivation: 扩展Shapley和Shubik(1971)的静态匹配模型，考虑代理人状态的动态演变和前瞻性行为，更贴近现实经济中的匹配过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Shapley和Shubik(1971)的可转移效用匹配理论，结合动态规划和均衡分析框架。
AI.method: 理论证明均衡存在性，提出两种计算平稳均衡的算法，引入计量经济学冲击处理未观测异质性，使用瑞典工程师数据进行实证估计。
AI.findings: 证明了时变代理类型分布均衡的存在性，表明这是社会规划者问题的解；证明了平稳均衡的存在性；成功估计了工作特定人力资本积累模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了静态匹配模型到动态环境，建立了动态匹配理论框架，证明了各类均衡的存在性和性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了计算动态匹配均衡的实用算法，开发了模型估计方法，为劳动力市场匹配等实际问题提供了分析工具。

title: Introducing The SPEAK: A Scalable Computer-Adaptive Tool to Measure Knowledge of Early Human Development
affiliations: , University of Chicago, University of Chicago - Department of Economics and University of Chicago

detail.title: Introducing The SPEAK: A Scalable Computer-Adaptive Tool to Measure Knowledge of Early Human Development
detail.abstract:
Research shows responsive caregiving enhances children's brain development, with parental knowledge predicting positive behaviors and outcomes. However, knowledge varies widely across educational levels, highlighting the need for targeted interventions. Despite evidence that this knowledge can be improved, no comprehensive metric exists for efficient assessment. We introduce SPEAK (Survey of Parent/Provider Expectations and Knowledge), a computer-adaptive tool grounded in item-response theory that we created, to address this gap by measuring parental and educator knowledge across development domains with precision and speed. This paper details SPEAK's development, including domain construction, cognitive interviewing, expert review, psychometric calibration, and validity evidence. SPEAK offers a flexible, scalable solution for clinical, educational, research, and policy settings. By identifying knowledge gaps, it enables tailored interventions, supports professional development, and informs policy, ultimately improving parent-child interactions and child outcomes. Our tool bridges critical gaps in assessing child development knowledge, advancing research and cross-sector collaboration to promote early childhood development worldwide.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: SPEAK是一个基于项目反应理论的计算机自适应工具，用于精确快速评估家长和教育工作者在儿童发展领域的知识水平，填补了现有评估工具的空白。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个全面、高效且可扩展的工具来评估家长和教育工作者在儿童发展领域的知识水平？

AI.findings: SPEAK工具成功开发，能够精确测量儿童发展知识，识别知识差距，为临床、教育、研究和政策环境提供灵活可扩展的解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了儿童发展知识评估的理论空白，建立了基于IRT的计算机自适应评估框架，推动了跨学科研究合作。
AI.practical_contributions: 为针对性干预、专业发展和政策制定提供数据支持，改善亲子互动和儿童发展结果，促进全球早期儿童发展。

title: Gender-Based Violence and Judge Responses
affiliations: Xiamen University - Wang Yanan Institute for Studies in Economics (WISE), University of Leicester - School of Business, Xiamen University - Paula and Gregory Chow Institute for Studies in Economics and University of Southern California

detail.title: Gender-Based Violence and Judge Responses
detail.abstract:
In China, only 37% of divorce petitions citing domestic violence are granted, with evidence suggesting that judges often prioritize preserving marriages even in cases of abuse. We investigate whether judicial decision-making can shift in response to broader social change. Exploiting the rise of the #MeToo movement, which reshaped societal perceptions of gender-based violence, we find that female judges in China became 8 percentage points more likely to grant divorces in domestic violence cases. These results suggest that judicial attitudes and actions on gender-based violence cases are malleable.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Transport in Low- and Middle-income Countries
affiliations: Tufts University

detail.title: Transport in Low- and Middle-income Countries
detail.abstract:
This brief survey reviews recent work on transportation in poor and middle-income countries. After reviewing a few key global facts and taking stock of the data available, it focuses on eight key themes that are emphasized in this literature relative to work on transportation in rich countries. In urban areas, these are private/informal transit, interactions with other informal markets, gender, bus rapid transit, and quantity-based congestion policy. Elsewhere, they are the legacy of colonialism, rural roads, and potential negative effects of improved transportation infrastructure.

title: A Guide to Climate Damages
affiliations: University of Arizona - Department of Economics, University of Michigan at Ann Arbor and Columbia University - School of International & Public Affairs (SIPA)

detail.title: A Guide to Climate Damages
detail.abstract:
Multiple lines of research aim to quantify the economic impacts of climate change, including through reduced-form and structural approaches. We show that the effects of climate change on economic activity depend on changes in weather across time and space: changes in contemporary weather have direct effects on output; changes in past weather and in expectations of future weather induce adaptation; and changes in weather elsewhere around the globe introduce a general equilibrium component. Using this framework, we argue that estimation of climate impacts faces a trilemma: a methodology can have at most two of (i) robustness to a particular economic model structure, (ii) interpretation as effects of persistent, widespread, anticipated climate change, and (iii) quasi-experimental identification. We summarize the literature on climate damages in light of the trilemma, with an emphasis on recent progress understanding adaptation and spatial spillovers. We propose directions for future work.

title: The Global Economic Impact of Climate Change: An Empirical Perspective
affiliations: Stanford University

detail.title: The Global Economic Impact of Climate Change: An Empirical Perspective
detail.abstract:
Empirical research has revolutionized how we understand the global economic impacts of climate change. Recent empirical analyses have tested theoretical ideas, challenged prior estimates, and revealed important and unexpected impacts. Further, the credibility and replicability of empirical results have played a critical role in guiding high-stakes climate policies. Here, I describe the landscape of empirical economic research on global impacts, I explain elements of modern analyses, I summarize recent findings on a range of topics, and I point towards promising new areas of investigation. In particular, I focus on empirical perspectives for six “grand challenges” in the field: understanding climate change’s global impact on economic output, health, conflict, food security, disasters, and migration. Overall, I argue that interwoven empirical findings across outcomes are aligning to paint an increasingly coherent picture of a future global economy impacted by climate change. Taking the literature as a whole, the global consequences of unmitigated climate change are likely to be substantial, unequal, negative in net economic value and potentially destabilizing.

title: China’s Lending to Developing Countries: From Boom to Bust
affiliations: Kiel Institute for the World Economy, National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), World Bank, Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR), International Monetary Fund (IMF), University of Maryland - School of Public Affairs, Harvard University, Harvard Kennedy School (HKS), Belfer Center for Science and International Affairs (BCSIA) , Harvard University - Center for Business and Government, Peterson Institute for International Economics and Kiel Institute for the World Economy

detail.title: China’s Lending to Developing Countries: From Boom to Bust
detail.abstract:
This paper provides a comprehensive overview of China’s lending to developing countries—a central feature of today’s international financial system. Building on our previous research and the work of others, we document the scale, destination, and terms of China’s overseas lending boom, as well as the lending bust and defaults that have followed. We compare China’s lending boom to past boom-bust cycles and discuss the implications of China’s rise as an international creditor on recipient countries and sovereign debt markets. The evidence indicates that Chinese state banks are assertive and commercially sophisticated lenders. For recipient countries, however, the jury is still out: it remains to be seen whether the gains from China’s lending—through growth and improved infrastructure—will outweigh the more immediate burdens of debt service or the multifaceted costs of default.

title: Jealousy of Trade: Exclusionary Preferences and Economic Nationalism
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, LSE and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Jealousy of Trade: Exclusionary Preferences and Economic Nationalism
detail.abstract:
This paper presents a new framework for understanding economic nationalism based on an empirically-validated desire for dominance, which generates a preference for exclusionary policies. We incorporate such preferences into a model of international trade. The model predicts that exclusionary preferences lead people to favor tariffs and protectionist policies that harm both their trading partner's and their own consumption. This implies that higher prices caused by exclusionary policies like tariffs will be more acceptable than those caused by non-exclusionary policies. We provide support for these predictions through two survey experiments, which also account for the role of cognitive biases and misinformation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于经验验证的支配欲望的经济民族主义新框架，该框架产生排他性政策偏好。将这种偏好纳入国际贸易模型后，预测排他性偏好会导致人们支持关税和保护主义政策，即使这些政策会损害贸易伙伴和自身的消费。通过两个调查实验验证了这一预测，并考虑了认知偏见和错误信息的作用。

AI.motivation: 传统经济理论难以解释为什么人们会支持损害自身经济利益的政策，需要从心理动机角度理解经济民族主义现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于支配欲望的经济民族主义框架，强调排他性偏好在贸易政策选择中的作用。
AI.method: 国际贸易理论模型构建和两个调查实验验证。

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于支配欲望的经济民族主义新理论框架，为理解非理性贸易政策偏好提供了新的理论视角。

title: What the Mercantilists Got Right
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Kennedy School (HKS)

detail.title: What the Mercantilists Got Right
detail.abstract:
Economics students today learn about mercantilism through Smith’s prism, as a series of logical and policy errors that Smith clarified and settled for good. But far from settled doctrine, mercantilism encapsulated a variety of pragmatic practices that survived Smith’s critique, often to good effect. It found echo in a continuous tradition of what later came to be called “developmentalism,” running from Alexander Hamilton and Friedrich List’s advocacy of trade protection to Hans Singer and Raul Prebisch’s ideas on import-substitution and, more recently, to East Asian models of export-oriented industrialization. Three of its core tenets hold continued appeal: the primacy of production and jobs (and of their composition) over consumption; preference for close, collaborative relationship between business and government over an arms’ length relationship; and the need for contextual, pragmatic, and often unorthodox policies over universal remedies and “best-practices.”

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估重商主义，认为它并非如亚当·斯密所批评的那样是逻辑错误，而是一系列实用政策实践，这些实践在后来的发展主义传统中持续存在并产生良好效果。
AI.research_question: 重商主义是否真的如亚当·斯密所批评的那样是过时的错误理论？其核心原则是否在现代经济发展中仍有价值？

AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了主流经济学对重商主义的传统批判，重新定位重商主义在发展经济学中的地位
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家提供了基于重商主义原则的实用政策框架，特别是在产业政策、贸易保护和政企关系方面

title: The Lower Boundary of Workplace Mistreatment: Do Small Slights Matter?
affiliations: Tel Aviv University, University of Pennsylvania and University of Pennsylvania Wharton School - Center for Human Resources

detail.title: The Lower Boundary of Workplace Mistreatment: Do Small Slights Matter?
detail.abstract:
Recent research in psychology, management, and more recently in economics, highlights the role of individual managers and their behavior in shaping employee performance. While emerging literature on harmful managerial behavior has focused primarily on severe forms of workplace mistreatment, especially various types of harassment, much less is known about its boundary conditions: How minor can a manager’s bad behavior be and still negatively affect employee performance? We study what appears to be a very minor workplace mistreatment—failing to deliver an expected birthday gift and greeting card on time—and examine its effect on subsequent employee performance. Using a dynamic difference-in-differences approach with detailed data from a national retail chain, we find that this small slight leads to over a 50% increase in employee absenteeism and a reduction of more than two working hours per month. Our analysis suggests that emotional responses to perceived workplace mistreatment drive the results. These findings indicate that even modest slights can meaningfully harm employee performance.

title: From the Classroom to the Ballot Box: Turnout and Partisan Consequences of Education
affiliations: University of Maryland, Northwestern University - Department of Managerial Economics and Decision Sciences (MEDS) and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: From the Classroom to the Ballot Box: Turnout and Partisan Consequences of Education
detail.abstract:
We estimate the impact of education on voter turnout and partisanship using a regression
discontinuity design based on school-entry cutoffs and exact date of birth. Drawing on nationwide
administrative voter registration data, we find that individuals who were slotted to enter school one
year earlier are more likely to vote and more likely to register as independents. These reduced-form
effects may be driven by changes in educational attainment or by differences in the quality of
individuals’ educational experiences. We leverage age-related heterogeneity in effect sizes to
isolate the role of educational attainment. Our results imply that an additional year of schooling
increases turnout by about 3 percentage points.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: A Narrative Account of the Great Inflation in the UK 1961-1997
affiliations: Rutgers University, New Brunswick - Department of Economics, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE), Bank of England and Bank of England - Monetary Analysis

detail.title: A Narrative Account of the Great Inflation in the UK 1961-1997
detail.abstract:
This narrative paper provides a detailed account of the Great Inflation in the United Kingdom from 1961 to 1997, serving as a companion to the analytical account of fiscal policy presented in Bordo, Bush, and Thomas (2025). We discuss the background fundamentals in place at the outset of the Great Inflation and document the distinct phases of inflation, the unique features of the UK’s experience relative to other advanced economies, and the interplay between fiscal, monetary, and incomes policies. By placing the UK’s inflationary episodes within their institutional and historical context, this paper offers a qualitative perspective that complements the quantitative analysis of the main paper and informs ongoing debates about the causes and consequences of persistent inflation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

detail.title: The Economic Geography of American Slavery
detail.abstract:
What would the antebellum American economy have looked like without slavery? Using new micro-data on the U.S. economy in 1860, we document that where free and enslaved workers live and how much they earn correlates strongly—but differently—with geographic proxies for agricultural productivity, disease, and ease of slave escape. To explain these patterns, we build a quantitative spatial model of slavery, where slaveholders coerce enslaved workers into supplying more labor, capture the proceeds of their labor, and assign them to sectors and occupations that maximize owner profits rather than worker welfare. Combining theory and data, we then quantify how dismantling the institution of slavery affected the spatial economy. We find that the economic impacts of emancipation are substantial, generating welfare gains for the enslaved of roughly 1,200%, while reducing welfare of free workers by 0.7% and eliminating slaveholder profit. Aggregate GDP rises by 9.1%, with a contraction in agricultural productivity counteracted by an expansion in manufacturing and services driven by an exodus of formerly enslaved workers out of agriculture and into the U.S. North.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过量化空间模型分析美国南北战争前奴隶制对经济的影响，发现废除奴隶制使被奴役者福利增长1200%，自由工人福利下降0.7%，GDP增长9.1%，农业生产力下降但制造业和服务业扩张。
AI.research_question: 如果没有奴隶制，美国南北战争前的经济会是什么样子？
AI.motivation: 量化奴隶制对美国经济的空间影响，理解废除奴隶制的经济后果
AI.theoretical_framework: 量化空间模型，奴隶主通过强制劳动获取利润，将奴隶分配到利润最大化而非福利最大化的部门和职业
AI.method: 使用1860年美国经济的新微观数据，结合地理生产力、疾病和奴隶逃亡难易度等代理变量，构建定量空间模型
AI.findings: 解放奴隶使被奴役者福利大幅提升1200%，自由工人福利下降0.7%，奴隶主利润消失，GDP增长9.1%，农业收缩但制造业和服务业扩张
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了奴隶制的定量空间模型，揭示了强制劳动制度对经济空间结构的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史制度变迁的经济影响提供了量化证据，对现代劳动力市场政策具有启示意义

title: Transshipment Hubs, Trade, and Supply Chains
affiliations: Michigan State University, Georgetown University, University of Oregon and Michigan State University

detail.title: Transshipment Hubs, Trade, and Supply Chains
detail.abstract:
The majority of global trade moves by sea through hub-and-spoke shipping networks. We investigate the returns to being a hub country by analyzing how transshipment activity shapes trade and supply chains. We show that most US imports---especially from smaller origin countries---are transshipped via key hubs, and transshipment is positively correlated with the hub's product-level trade. Leveraging the indirect shipping network structure to construct an instrument, we find that transshipment increases hubs' imports from origins for which they facilitate trade and exports of downstream goods, highlighting their central role in shaping modern global trade and supply chain dynamics.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了枢纽国家在海运网络中的收益，发现转运活动显著影响贸易和供应链。美国大部分进口（特别是来自小国的）通过关键枢纽转运，转运与枢纽的产品级贸易呈正相关。利用间接航运网络结构构建工具变量，研究发现转运增加了枢纽从其所服务原产国的进口以及下游产品的出口。
AI.research_question: 转运活动如何塑造枢纽国家的贸易和供应链？
AI.motivation: 全球贸易主要通过枢纽-辐射型海运网络进行，但枢纽国家的收益机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 枢纽-辐射网络理论、国际贸易理论、供应链管理理论
AI.method: 利用间接航运网络结构构建工具变量进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1) 美国大部分进口（特别是来自小国的）通过关键枢纽转运；2) 转运与枢纽的产品级贸易呈正相关；3) 转运增加了枢纽从其所服务原产国的进口；4) 转运增加了枢纽下游产品的出口
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了枢纽国家在全球贸易网络中的核心作用机制，深化了对转运活动影响贸易和供应链的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业理解全球贸易网络结构提供了实证依据，有助于优化供应链管理和贸易政策

title: Optimal Trade Policies and Market Power in General Equilibrium Trade Models
affiliations: University of Rochester - Department of Economics, University of Rochester - Department of Economics and The Chinese University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Optimal Trade Policies and Market Power in General Equilibrium Trade Models
detail.abstract:
We derive optimal trade policies in a multi-country, multi-sector general-equilibrium model that unifies a wide range of supply-side assumptions. Under our CES supply system, which nests most existing specifications, two-country optimal tariffs and export taxes across sectors depend only on elasticity parameters and relative market shares. With multiple countries, country and sector interdependencies—due to the cross-country trade network—make optimal tariffs imposed by the home country differ across countries and sectors while converging within sectors. Only when foreign countries do not trade with each other do the home country’s optimal policies depend solely on bilateral trade. Using trade data, we quantify optimal policies and find that ignoring interdependencies can lead to substantially lower welfare gains for the home country.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文在多国多部门一般均衡模型中推导最优贸易政策，发现考虑国家间贸易网络相互依赖关系对制定最优关税政策至关重要。忽略这种相互依赖会导致本国福利收益大幅降低。
AI.research_question: 在多国多部门贸易模型中，最优贸易政策（关税和出口税）如何制定？国家间贸易网络相互依赖如何影响最优政策？
AI.motivation: 现有贸易政策研究往往忽视多国环境下的相互依赖关系，需要开发统一框架来分析考虑贸易网络效应的最优贸易政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CES供给系统的多国多部门一般均衡模型，该框架囊括了现有大多数供给侧假设，强调贸易网络中的相互依赖关系。
AI.method: 理论推导与数值模拟相结合，使用贸易数据进行量化分析，比较考虑和不考虑相互依赖关系时的政策效果。
AI.findings: 1) 两国情况下最优关税和出口税仅取决于弹性参数和相对市场份额；2) 多国情况下本国最优关税因贸易网络相互依赖而因国家和部门而异；3) 只有在外围国家之间不贸易时，本国最优政策才仅取决于双边贸易；4) 忽略相互依赖会显著降低本国福利收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了统一的多国多部门贸易政策分析框架；2) 揭示了贸易网络相互依赖对最优政策制定的关键作用；3) 提供了考虑一般均衡效应的最优贸易政策理论基准。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了考虑全球贸易网络相互依赖的贸易政策设计指导；2) 量化分析显示忽略相互依赖会导致福利损失；3) 为实际贸易政策评估提供了实证方法。

title: Prosecutorial Reform and Local Crime Rates
affiliations: Cornell University, Arnold Ventures, New York University Department of Politics, New York University (NYU) - New York University and University of Notre Dame

detail.title: Prosecutorial Reform and Local Crime Rates
detail.abstract:
Many communities across the United States have elected reform-minded prosecutors who seek to safely reduce the reach and burden of the criminal justice system. In this paper, we use variation in the timing of when these prosecutors took office across jurisdictions to empirically characterize their policy changes and estimate downstream effects on prison incarceration rates, local reported crime rates, and drug mortality rates. We find that after a reform prosecutor takes office there are consistent and often statistically significant decreases in charging and conviction rates for nonviolent misdemeanor offenses, particularly misdemeanor drug offenses, but not for violent or felony offenses. We find little to no downstream effects on prison incarceration rates and no effects on local reported crime rates or drug mortality rates. These findings suggest that the types of policies being implemented by reform prosecutors appear to be decreasing the footprint of the criminal justice system without adverse effects on public safety.

AI.tldr: 改革派检察官上任后，对非暴力轻罪（特别是毒品轻罪）的起诉和定罪率显著下降，但对暴力或重罪无影响，且未对监狱监禁率、犯罪率或毒品死亡率产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: 改革派检察官的政策变化对刑事司法系统的影响是什么？

AI.method: 利用不同司法管辖区改革派检察官上任时间的差异进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 改革派检察官上任后，非暴力轻罪（特别是毒品轻罪）的起诉和定罪率显著下降，但对暴力或重罪无影响；监狱监禁率、犯罪率和毒品死亡率无显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了改革派检察官政策效果的实证证据，支持刑事司法改革理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明改革派检察官的政策可以在不损害公共安全的情况下减少刑事司法系统的负担。

title: Social Costs of Work Disruptions: Evidence from Physicians and their Patients
affiliations: Harvard University, University of California, Berkeley and

detail.title: Social Costs of Work Disruptions: Evidence from Physicians and their Patients
detail.abstract:
Work disruptions among women are common and costly for workers and firms, but do consumers also shoulder some of these costs? We study the impact of physicians’ births—a large, temporary shock to women’s labor supply—on their patients’ access to care, using administrative Medicaid claims data from California. Female physicians reduce their office visits by 85% in the quarter after giving birth, but return nearly to pre-birth levels within two years. These supply disruptions generate persistent effects on child patients: those whose primary care physician gives birth are less likely to see their usual physician for up to two years and receive less preventative care, including a 50% reduction in vaccination claims and a 42% reduction in lead testing. In contrast, we find little impact on adult patients. The lasting effects on children coincide with fewer pediatrician encounters overall, consistent with limited availability of substitute providers and the central role of pediatricians in monitoring children’s preventative care. Our findings demonstrate how shocks to women’s labor supply can generate persistent consumer welfare losses.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 女性医生生育导致其医疗服务供给暂时中断，对儿童患者的预防性医疗产生持续负面影响，包括疫苗接种和铅检测大幅减少，但对成人患者影响较小。
AI.research_question: 女性医生生育对其患者医疗服务可及性的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 女性工作中断对工人和企业都造成成本，但消费者是否也承担部分成本尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 女性劳动供给冲击对消费者福利的影响理论
AI.method: 使用加州医疗补助计划的行政索赔数据，分析女性医生生育前后患者医疗服务的变化
AI.findings: 女性医生生育后季度内办公室访问减少85%，两年内恢复；儿童患者两年内更少见到常规医生，预防性医疗减少（疫苗接种减少50%，铅检测减少42%）；成人患者影响较小
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了女性劳动供给冲击如何产生持续的消费者福利损失
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗系统应对女性医生生育带来的服务中断提供政策启示，强调儿童预防性医疗连续性的重要性

title: Who Rides Out the Storm? The Immediate Post-College Transition and its Role in Socioeconomic Earnings Gaps
affiliations: Columbia University, Columbia University, Columbia University and Columbia University

detail.title: Who Rides Out the Storm? The Immediate Post-College Transition and its Role in Socioeconomic Earnings Gaps
detail.abstract:
Despite a large earnings premium for bachelor’s degree completion in general, graduates from low-income families earn substantially less than graduates from high-income families. While prior research has documented the role of college quality and major choice in explaining these gaps, we examine undermatching on a different margin: the first (post-college) job transition. The transition from college to the labor market can be challenging to navigate, and students with financial, informational, or other disadvantages during the job search may be more likely to “undermatch” to their first job. Using administrative data from a large, urban, public college system, we document large gaps in earnings five years after graduation by SES (proxied by financial aid receipt) that remain unexplained even after controlling for GPA, college, field of study, and other pre-graduation characteristics. We then examine how features of the initial job transition relate to longer-term earnings, and to what extent differences in the first job transition can explain later SES earnings gaps. Our results show that first job transitions are rocky for many graduates, strongly predict earnings at Year 5, and are a substantial mediator of socioeconomic gaps in earnings five years after college graduation—reducing the unexplained gap by almost two-thirds.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，尽管大学学位普遍带来收入溢价，但来自低收入家庭的毕业生收入远低于高收入家庭毕业生。研究聚焦于首次工作转换中的"不匹配"现象，发现第一份工作的过渡质量强烈预测毕业5年后的收入，并能解释近三分之二的社会经济收入差距。
AI.research_question: 首次工作转换如何影响大学毕业生的长期收入？第一份工作过渡中的差异能在多大程度上解释社会经济地位导致的收入差距？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究关注大学质量和专业选择对收入差距的影响，但首次工作转换这一重要环节的研究相对不足。来自弱势背景的学生在求职过程中可能面临财务、信息等障碍，导致"不匹配"就业。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场过渡理论和不匹配理论，关注社会经济地位如何通过影响首次工作转换质量进而影响长期职业发展。
AI.method: 使用大型城市公立大学系统的行政数据，控制GPA、大学、专业等毕业前特征，分析毕业5年后收入与社会经济地位的关系。
AI.findings: 第一份工作过渡对许多毕业生来说充满挑战，强烈预测毕业5年后的收入水平，是社会经济收入差距的重要中介因素，能解释近三分之二的未解释收入差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了关于高等教育回报不平等的研究，强调了首次工作转换在解释社会经济收入差距中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校职业服务部门和政策制定者提供启示，应特别关注弱势学生在首次求职过程中的支持，以减少长期收入不平等。

title: Returns to Trainees in a Highly Regulated Labor Market
affiliations: Cornell University, Baylor University and Brown University

detail.title: Returns to Trainees in a Highly Regulated Labor Market
detail.abstract:
Human capital formation enhances worker productivity and firm performance. However, firms may not fully internalize the financial benefits from investing in employee skill-building, which can disincentivize worker training and suggest roles for government support. We examine such tradeoffs in the context of physician training (i.e., “residency” programs). Using the universe of Medicare inpatient and outpatient records from 2014-2019 and differences-in-differences analyses, we show that hospitals’ productivity and revenues grow by 10-20% after underwriting a procedure-oriented residency––though heterogeneity exists. The hospitals benefiting from trainee labor conservatively net over $2 million in steady-state, revealing substantive private incentives to finance physician training.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 医院投资医生培训项目可获得显著经济回报，生产率与收入增长10-20%，稳态下净收益超过200万美元，表明存在私人激励来资助医生培训。
AI.research_question: 医院投资医生培训项目是否能够获得足够的经济回报来激励其继续资助此类培训？
AI.motivation: 企业可能无法完全内化员工技能培训的财务收益，这可能导致培训投资不足，需要政府支持。在医生培训背景下研究这种权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、企业培训投资决策理论、外部性与内部化问题
AI.method: 使用2014-2019年医疗保险住院和门诊记录的完整数据集，采用双重差分分析方法
AI.findings: 医院在资助程序导向的住院医师培训后，生产率和收入增长10-20%，受益医院在稳态下净收益保守估计超过200万美元
AI.theory_contributions: 为人力资本投资的外部性和内部化问题提供了实证证据，揭示了企业培训投资的私人激励程度
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院管理者提供培训投资回报的量化证据，为政策制定者提供关于医生培训资助机制设计的参考

title: Community Rating and Vertical Price Distortions in Insurance Menus
affiliations: Wisconsin School of Business, Tsinghua University - School of Economics & Management, Wisconsin School of Business and University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Community Rating and Vertical Price Distortions in Insurance Menus
detail.abstract:
How does community rating distort relative prices for vertically differentiated plans in insurance markets? We show that common community-rating approaches can distort price differentials in the opposite direction to the distortions in overall price levels. Partial age-based community rating in the U.S. private health insurance exchanges causes older individuals to pay marginal prices for generous coverage significantly above marginal cost, while younger enrollees are subsidized on the margin. These distortions are large enough that older individuals often face and sometimes choose dominated options. We present simulations and theoretical discussions of community rating’s impacts on efficiency and distributional outcomes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 美国私人健康保险交易所中的部分基于年龄的社区评级扭曲了价格差异，导致老年人支付慷慨保险的边际价格显著高于边际成本，而年轻参保者获得边际补贴。这些扭曲足够大，以至于老年人经常面临有时选择被主导的选项。
AI.research_question: 社区评级如何扭曲垂直差异化保险计划的相对价格？
AI.motivation: 研究社区评级政策对保险市场中价格差异的扭曲效应，特别是对老年人和年轻人之间的价格差异影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社区评级理论、保险市场定价理论、垂直差异化产品定价理论
AI.method: 模拟分析和理论讨论
AI.findings: 部分基于年龄的社区评级导致老年人支付慷慨保险的边际价格显著高于边际成本，而年轻参保者获得边际补贴，这些扭曲足够大以至于老年人经常面临被主导的选项。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社区评级不仅扭曲整体价格水平，还会在相反方向上扭曲价格差异，深化了对保险市场定价扭曲机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于社区评级政策对效率和分配结果影响的重要实证证据，有助于改进保险市场规制政策。

title: Information, Spillovers, or Hassle Costs? Effects of Medicaid Prior Authorization on Preschool Antipsychotic Prescribing
affiliations: Yale University and Columbia University

detail.title: Information, Spillovers, or Hassle Costs? Effects of Medicaid Prior Authorization on Preschool Antipsychotic Prescribing
detail.abstract:
We examine information versus hassle costs in the context of Medicaid prior authorization requirements for preschool antipsychotic prescribing. Such prescribing increased in the 1990s, despite substantial side effects and the absence of FDA approval. State Medicaid programs began to require prior authorization for antipsychotic prescribing to young children after 2005. We evaluate these policies using hand-collected policy data and national prescription data for 2006-2019. We find that prior authorization reduced prescriptions to children under six by 22-30% in the two years after implementation. There were no effects on privately insured or older children, suggesting little role for information spillovers.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了医疗补助计划对学龄前儿童抗精神病药物处方的前授权要求，发现这些政策在实施后两年内使6岁以下儿童的处方量减少了22-30%，但对私人保险或年龄较大儿童没有影响。
AI.research_question: 医疗补助计划对学龄前儿童抗精神病药物处方的前授权要求如何影响处方量？
AI.motivation: 1990年代学龄前儿童抗精神病药物处方增加，尽管存在显著副作用且缺乏FDA批准，各州医疗补助计划从2005年开始要求前授权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息成本与麻烦成本理论，分析政策干预对处方行为的影响。
AI.method: 使用手工收集的政策数据和2006-2019年全国处方数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 前授权使6岁以下儿童处方量在实施后两年内减少22-30%，对私人保险或年龄较大儿童无影响，表明信息溢出效应很小。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政策干预对医疗处方行为的影响提供了实证证据，验证了信息成本与麻烦成本理论在医疗政策中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗政策制定者提供了关于前授权政策有效性的证据，有助于设计更有效的医疗监管政策。

title: Historical Government: Origins, Evolution and Varieties
affiliations: Northwestern University - Kellogg School of Management

detail.title: Historical Government: Origins, Evolution and Varieties
detail.abstract:
This chapter reviews the origins, evolution, and modern forms of government, and proposes a research agenda. It contends that rather than being a homogeneous form of patrimonialism, early government was diverse and, at times, fostered order and prosperity. Its subsequent development did not follow an ‘evolutionary’ path to rational-legal government but was characterized by innovation and frequent collapse. Successful modern states do not all look alike, but follow several different models, as historical states have done.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本章回顾了政府的起源、演变和现代形式，并提出了研究议程。认为早期政府并非单一的世袭主义形式，而是多样化的，有时能促进秩序与繁荣。政府发展并非遵循理性-法律政府的'进化'路径，而是以创新和频繁崩溃为特征。成功的现代国家并不都相似，而是遵循几种不同模式，正如历史上的国家一样。
AI.research_question: 政府的起源、演变路径和现代形式是什么？政府发展是否遵循单一的进化模式？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统认为政府发展遵循单一进化路径的观点，揭示政府形式的多样性和复杂性
AI.theoretical_framework: 政府起源理论、制度变迁理论、比较政治学理论
AI.method: 文献综述和历史比较分析
AI.findings: 1) 早期政府形式多样，并非单一世袭主义；2) 政府发展路径以创新和崩溃为特征，非单一进化；3) 现代成功国家遵循多种不同模式
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战政府发展的线性进化观，提出政府多样性和多路径发展理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理解政府发展的多元视角，避免简单照搬单一模式

title: Do Investors Price Risk Differently? Evidence of Volatility Feedback in Developed vs. Emerging Stock Markets
affiliations: Quinnipiac University and Quinnipiac University

detail.title: Do Investors Price Risk Differently? Evidence of Volatility Feedback in Developed vs. Emerging Stock Markets
detail.abstract: This paper examines how investors in developed and emerging markets implement the intertemporal risk-return relation (IRRR) through the volatility feedback effect (VFE). In developed markets, we find the VFE is consistently positive and statistically significant, particularly during adverse states and high-volatility periods. These results suggest that investors rationally incorporate volatility shocks into pricing decisions, reinforcing the IRRR as a state-contingent mechanism. By contrast, in emerging markets the VFE is largely insignificant, indicating a breakdown of the IRRR and a failure to price volatility risk. This sharp asymmetry implies that, while the IRRR functions as an effective pricing framework in developed markets, its influence dissipates in emerging markets. Overall, our findings establish the VFE as a novel and informative criterion for distinguishing international equity markets and deepening the understanding of global risk pricing.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过波动反馈效应检验发达市场和新兴市场中的跨期风险-收益关系。发达市场中VFE显著为正，表明投资者理性地将波动冲击纳入定价决策；而新兴市场中VFE不显著，表明跨期风险-收益关系失效。
AI.research_question: 发达市场和新兴市场中的投资者如何通过波动反馈效应实施跨期风险-收益关系？
AI.motivation: 理解不同市场环境下投资者对波动风险定价的差异，以及跨期风险-收益关系在国际市场中的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨期风险-收益关系理论、波动反馈效应理论、国际金融市场理论
AI.method: 实证分析发达市场和新兴市场的波动反馈效应，检验其在不利状态和高波动时期的显著性
AI.findings: 发达市场中VFE持续显著为正，特别在不利状态和高波动时期；新兴市场中VFE基本不显著，表明跨期风险-收益关系失效
AI.theory_contributions: 确立VFE作为区分国际股票市场的新标准，深化对全球风险定价的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供在不同市场环境下风险定价的指导，帮助识别市场效率差异

title: Active or passive: Deposit investments of individual investors
affiliations: Copenhagen Business School, Copenhagen Business School, Copenhagen Business School and Copenhagen Business School

detail.title: Active or passive: Deposit investments of individual investors
detail.abstract: Using detailed register-based data with information on individuals’ deposit holdings, we test whether individuals are active investors when it comes to their deposit holdings and why they hold deposits. We provide three main findings. First, we show that deposit investors are active, as they actively reduce their deposit holdings following an exogenous increase captured by unexpected inheritances. Second, following large exogeneous deposit inflows, people reallocate away from low-return deposits to higher expected-return assets, such as bonds and stocks, in line with classical deposit-demand theories. Third, people use deposits and voluntary unemployment insurance as substitutes, meaning deposits are used to insure against sudden negative income shocks.

AI.tldr: 基于详细的存款持有数据，研究发现个人是积极的存款投资者，会主动调整存款配置。继承意外收入后，人们会减少存款持有，将资金重新配置到债券和股票等高收益资产，并将存款与自愿失业保险视为替代品。
AI.research_question: 个人是否是其存款持有的积极投资者？为什么人们持有存款？
AI.motivation: 理解个人在存款管理中的行为模式及其持有存款的动机，检验古典存款需求理论在个人层面的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 古典存款需求理论、资产配置理论、预防性储蓄理论
AI.method: 使用详细的登记数据，分析个人存款持有情况，通过意外继承作为外生冲击来检验存款调整行为。
AI.findings: 1) 存款投资者是积极的，意外继承后会主动减少存款持有；2) 大额外生存款流入后，人们会将资金从低收益存款重新配置到高预期收益资产；3) 存款与自愿失业保险存在替代关系，存款用于防范突发负面收入冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了古典存款需求理论在个人层面的适用性，扩展了对存款作为预防性储蓄工具的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构设计存款产品和投资建议提供实证依据，帮助个人优化资产配置决策。

title: Adverse Selection Without Asset Exchange: Evidence from Synthetic Risk Transfers
affiliations: University of Navarra

detail.title: Adverse Selection Without Asset Exchange: Evidence from Synthetic Risk Transfers
detail.abstract: I study adverse selection in synthetic risk transfers. Using public data on Fannie Mae's single-family mortgages and transaction data by Moody's, I document that the mortgages synthetically sold exhibit worse ex ante quality and higher unconditional default rates. Conditional on ex ante risk, I find that the quality gap comes from loans with high credit scores, for which I do not see a higher interest rate to compensate. The merged dataset reveals a small set of loans excluded from the public data, allowing me to test for adverse disclosure. Higher-quality loans are retained for longer, consistent with equilibrium signaling under adverse selection.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了房利美合成风险转移中的逆向选择问题，发现被转移的抵押贷款具有更差的事前质量和更高的无条件违约率，特别是在高信用评分贷款中存在质量差距但未获得利率补偿，揭示了信息披露不足和逆向选择下的均衡信号机制。
AI.research_question: 房利美合成风险转移中是否存在逆向选择？被转移的抵押贷款是否具有更差的质量特征？
AI.motivation: 研究合成风险转移中的逆向选择问题，因为这类交易在金融市场上日益重要但缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逆向选择理论、信号理论、信息披露理论
AI.method: 使用房利美单户抵押贷款的公开数据和穆迪的交易数据，进行实证分析和数据匹配。
AI.findings: 1) 被转移的抵押贷款具有更差的事前质量和更高的无条件违约率；2) 在高信用评分贷款中存在质量差距但未获得利率补偿；3) 发现被排除在公开数据之外的小部分贷款；4) 高质量贷款被保留更长时间，符合逆向选择下的均衡信号机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为合成风险转移中的逆向选择提供了实证证据，拓展了信息披露和信号理论在金融风险管理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构的风险管理决策提供参考，揭示了合成风险转移中可能存在的质量问题和信息披露不足。

title: Do Investors Price Risk Differently? Evidence of Volatility Feedback in Developed vs. Emerging Stock Markets
affiliations: Quinnipiac University and Quinnipiac University

detail.title: Do Investors Price Risk Differently? Evidence of Volatility Feedback in Developed vs. Emerging Stock Markets
detail.abstract: This paper examines how investors in developed and emerging markets implement the intertemporal risk-return relation (IRRR) through the volatility feedback effect (VFE). In developed markets, we find the VFE is consistently positive and statistically significant, particularly during adverse states and high-volatility periods. By contrast, in emerging markets the VFE is largely insignificant, indicating a breakdown of the IRRR and a failure to price volatility risk. This sharp asymmetry implies that, while the IRRR functions as an effective pricing framework in developed markets, its influence dissipates in emerging markets. Overall, our findings establish the VFE as a novel and informative criterion for distinguishing international equity markets and deepening the understanding of global risk pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了发达市场和新兴市场投资者如何通过波动率反馈效应(VFE)实现跨期风险-收益关系(IRRR)。研究发现：发达市场中VFE始终为正且显著，特别是在不利状态和高波动期；而新兴市场中VFE基本不显著，表明IRRR失效。
AI.research_question: 发达市场和新兴市场投资者如何通过波动率反馈效应实施跨期风险-收益关系？
AI.motivation: 理解不同市场环境下投资者对波动率风险的定价行为差异，以及跨期风险-收益关系在全球市场的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨期风险-收益关系(IRRR)、波动率反馈效应(VFE)、状态依赖定价机制
AI.method: 实证分析发达市场和新兴市场的波动率反馈效应，比较不同市场状态下的表现
AI.findings: 发达市场：VFE始终为正且统计显著，特别是在不利状态和高波动期；新兴市场：VFE基本不显著，IRRR失效

title: Government Recommendations and Health Behaviors: Evidence from Breast Cancer Screening Guidelines
affiliations: American University and University of Georgia

detail.title: Government Recommendations and Health Behaviors: Evidence from Breast Cancer Screening Guidelines
detail.abstract:
We provide novel evidence on how healthcare decision-making responds to changes in government recommendations by studying the United States Preventive Services Task Force’s 2009 decision to stop recommending mammogram screenings for women aged 40-49. Using a difference-in-differences identification strategy, we find that the guideline revision reduced mammography among 40-49-year-old women by 6-10 percent (from a baseline rate of 48.8 percent) relative to their older counterparts. We also identify large spillovers onto women aged 30-39 who were subsequently 25 percent less likely to receive a mammogram recommendation (from a baseline rate of 22.8 percent) and up to 60 percent less likely to receive a mammogram (from a baseline rate of 12.6 percent). Additional analyses suggest the revision reduced overdiagnosis of early-stage tumors. Finally, we find that the 2009 update increased confusion about recommendations for preventing cancer.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国预防服务工作组2009年停止推荐40-49岁女性进行乳腺X光筛查的决定对医疗决策的影响。研究发现该指南修订使40-49岁女性的筛查率下降6-10%，并产生溢出效应，导致30-39岁女性筛查率下降60%。指南修订减少了早期肿瘤的过度诊断，但也增加了关于癌症预防建议的困惑。
AI.research_question: 医疗保健决策如何响应政府建议的变化？具体研究美国预防服务工作组2009年停止推荐40-49岁女性乳腺X光筛查的决定对筛查行为的影响。
AI.motivation: 了解医疗指南修订如何影响实际医疗决策和患者行为，特别是当建议从推荐转向不推荐时的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和医疗决策理论，研究政策建议变化对个体医疗行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用双重差分识别策略，比较不同年龄段女性在指南修订前后的乳腺X光筛查行为变化。
AI.findings: 指南修订使40-49岁女性筛查率下降6-10%（基线率48.8%），30-39岁女性筛查率下降60%（基线率12.6%），同时减少了早期肿瘤的过度诊断，但增加了关于癌症预防建议的困惑。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政策建议变化对医疗行为的影响提供了实证证据，揭示了医疗决策中的溢出效应和认知困惑现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗政策制定者提供关于指南修订实际影响的量化证据，有助于更精准地评估政策变化的社会成本和收益。

title: Banking Crises, Nonlinear Export Elasticities, and the Dominant Currency Paradigm
affiliations: Brookings Institution and Cornell University - Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management

detail.title: Banking Crises, Nonlinear Export Elasticities, and the Dominant Currency Paradigm
detail.abstract:
The dominant currency paradigm posits that dollar invoicing reduces the potency of exchange rate depreciations in boosting export volumes. This implies that export elasticities with respect to the exchange rate are small, rendering even large depreciations ineffectual in the short term. We incorporate two innovations versus existing work. First, we allow for nonlinearities, permitting large depreciations to disproportionately lift exports. Second, we control for banking crises, which accompany many depreciations. Our baseline export elasticity—without nonlinearities or banking crisis controls—is -0.3, consistent with prevailing “elasticity pessimism.” This elasticity rises to between -0.5 and -0.8 within two years for depreciations above 20 percent without banking crises.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，当汇率贬值超过20%且没有伴随银行业危机时，出口弹性在两年内会从-0.3上升至-0.5到-0.8，表明大额贬值对出口有显著促进作用。
AI.research_question: 汇率贬值对出口量的影响是否存在非线性效应？大额贬值是否比小额贬值更能刺激出口？
AI.motivation: 主流货币范式认为美元计价降低了汇率贬值对出口的刺激作用，导致出口弹性较小，即使大幅贬值在短期内也效果有限。现有研究可能忽略了非线性效应和银行业危机的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主导货币范式，强调美元计价在贸易中的核心作用；汇率传递理论；出口弹性理论。
AI.method: 计量经济学分析，引入非线性效应和银行业危机控制变量，比较不同贬值幅度下的出口弹性变化。
AI.findings: 基准出口弹性为-0.3，符合'弹性悲观主义'；当贬值超过20%且无银行业危机时，两年内出口弹性上升至-0.5到-0.8。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统的线性汇率弹性假设，揭示了贬值幅度与出口响应之间的非线性关系；强调了银行业危机在汇率传导机制中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更精确的汇率政策评估工具，特别是在考虑大额贬值政策时需要考虑银行业状况；对发展中国家汇率管理具有重要指导意义。

title: Exorbitant Changes in Three Parts
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and University of Virginia - Darden Business School

detail.title: Exorbitant Changes in Three Parts
detail.abstract:
We document that the positive differential on international portfolio returns, one aspect of the U.S. exorbitant privilege, has disappeared in three parts. Part One: U.S. international liabilities used to be mostly in low-return bonds while its international assets were largely in high-returning equities, thus naturally producing a positive return differential. More recently, however, U.S. equity liabilities have increased sharply, reducing this compositional tailwind. Part Two: While the exorbitant privilege literature has focused on expected returns as proxied by the sample arithmetic mean, the geometric mean is also required to produce an unbiased estimate of expected returns. Incorporating geometric means greatly reduces the returns differential. Part Three is a combined switch a) from aggregate to comprehensive security-level data to more accurately calculate returns and b) from expected to actual realized returns that take into account the timing and magnitude of portfolio flows. The combined effect of these changes is that over the past two decades the U.S. portfolio returns differential was not 228 bps but zero, and it is expected to be zero for the next decade.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三部分分析表明，美国国际投资组合的正向回报差异（过度特权的一个方面）已经消失。研究发现，过去20年美国投资组合回报差异实际上为零，而非传统认为的228个基点。
AI.research_question: 美国国际投资组合的回报差异是否仍然存在？传统的过度特权观点是否仍然成立？
AI.motivation: 重新评估美国在国际投资中的所谓"过度特权"，质疑传统研究中可能存在的计量偏差和方法论问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际金融理论、投资组合理论、回报计算理论（算术平均与几何平均的区别）、资产配置理论
AI.method: 三部分分析法：1) 资产组合构成变化分析 2) 算术平均与几何平均回报计算方法比较 3) 从汇总数据转向证券层面数据，从预期回报转向实际实现回报
AI.findings: 过去20年美国国际投资组合的回报差异实际上为零，而非传统认为的228个基点；预期未来十年也将保持零差异
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了美国"过度特权"的传统观点，提出了更准确的回报计算方法，强调几何平均在预期回报估计中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际投资者和政策制定者提供了更准确的投资回报评估框架，有助于重新理解全球资本流动和投资策略

title: Quarantine policy against shocks in the international financial network system: a theoretical investigation
affiliations: Aoyama Gakuin University, Tohoku University and Gifu Shotoku Gakuen University

detail.title: Quarantine policy against shocks in the international financial network system: a theoretical investigation
detail.abstract: This study theoretically investigates how quarantine policies in the international financial network system should be implemented if financial shocks hit the system. The network comprises either binary (BUN) or valued undirected networks (VUN). We prove that the network administrator maximizes the reduction of spillover effects of shocks over the network when they implement the quarantine policy in the financial center[[EQUATION]]the country with the largest degree of node in the BUN or degree of strength in the VUN[[EQUATION]]for each BUN or VUN system. Finally, we conduct simulation studies on some hypothetical network models to illustrate our results.

AI.tldr: 本研究证明在国际金融网络系统中，当金融冲击发生时，网络管理员应在金融中心（即节点度数最大的国家）实施隔离政策，以最大化减少冲击的溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 在国际金融网络系统中，应如何实施隔离政策以应对金融冲击？
AI.motivation: 研究金融冲击在国际金融网络中的传播机制，为政策制定者提供有效的干预策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于复杂网络理论，分析二进制无向网络（BUN）和加权无向网络（VUN）中的冲击传播。
AI.method: 理论证明和模拟研究，使用假设的网络模型进行验证。
AI.findings: 在金融中心（节点度数最大的国家）实施隔离政策能最大化减少冲击的溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融网络中的政策干预提供了理论依据，明确了最优干预点的选择标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管机构和政策制定者提供了具体的操作指南，帮助他们在危机时更有效地实施隔离措施。

title: HOW DO STOCK MARKET EXPERIENCES SHAPE WEALTH INEQUALITY?
affiliations: University of Guelph

detail.title: HOW DO STOCK MARKET EXPERIENCES SHAPE WEALTH INEQUALITY?
detail.abstract: This paper develops a continuous-time OLG model, incorporating rare disasters and agents who learn more from their own experiences. Disasters such as the Great Depression make investors distrustful of the market. Generations that experience disasters save in the form of safer portfolios, even if similar disasters are not likely to occur again during their lifetimes. “Fearing to attempt” therefore inhibits wealth accumulation by these “depression babies” relative to other generations. This effect is amplified in the general equilibrium since the equity premium is relatively high following a disaster. When calibrated to US data, the model can explain around half of the old-to-young wealth ratio decrease between the Great Depression and the 1980s, and around 7% of the subsequent increase. The model can also explain about a quarter of the increase of top 1% wealth shares and is consistent with observations of life cycle portfolio choices, and changes in asset returns following disasters.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含罕见灾难和基于经验学习的连续时间OLG模型，发现经历过灾难的投资者会持有更安全的投资组合，这种"不敢尝试"效应抑制了"大萧条一代"的财富积累，能解释美国数据中约一半的代际财富比率变化。
AI.research_question: 罕见灾难和基于经验的学习如何影响代际财富积累和资产配置？
AI.motivation: 理解为什么经历过灾难（如大萧条）的投资者会持续持有更安全的投资组合，以及这种"不敢尝试"效应对代际财富分配的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间世代交叠模型（OLG）、罕见灾难理论、基于经验的学习理论
AI.method: 构建连续时间OLG模型，纳入罕见灾难和基于经验的学习机制，并用美国数据进行校准分析
AI.findings: 经历过灾难的投资者会持有更安全的投资组合；"不敢尝试"效应抑制了"大萧条一代"的财富积累；模型能解释约50%的代际财富比率下降和7%的后续上升；能解释约25%的财富前1%份额增加
AI.theory_contributions: 将罕见灾难和基于经验的学习整合到连续时间OLG框架中；提出了"不敢尝试"效应的理论机制；解释了代际财富分配差异
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史灾难对长期财富分配的影响提供理论依据；对资产配置和代际财富转移政策有参考价值

title: Banking Reform, Credit Allocation, and Local Real Effects: Evidence from India
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Bristol, University of Edinburgh and University of Essex - Essex Business School

detail.title: Banking Reform, Credit Allocation, and Local Real Effects: Evidence from India
detail.abstract: We leverage the Reserve Bank of India’s 2006 Bank Authorization Policy as a quasi-natural experiment to study effects on credit markets, capital misallocation, and firm outcomes. We find asymmetric responses: private-sector bank branches expanded by 16.3% in underbanked districts relative to banked districts, while public-sector banks showed no systematic expansion. The resulting private-sector lending reduced the marginal revenue product of capital (MRPK) of ex-ante high-MRPK firms by about 60%, lowering capital misallocation. We highlight the efficacy of financial reforms in alleviating misallocation under mixed-ownership banking environments in developing economies.

AI.tldr: 利用印度央行2006年银行授权政策作为准自然实验，研究发现私人银行在欠发达地区扩张16.3%，降低了高资本边际收益企业的MRPK约60%，缓解了资本错配问题。
AI.research_question: 金融改革在混合所有制银行环境下如何影响信贷市场、资本错配和企业结果？
AI.motivation: 研究发展中国家金融改革在混合所有制银行环境中的效果，特别是对资本配置效率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融发展理论、资本错配理论和银行所有制理论，探讨不同所有制银行对信贷分配的影响。
AI.method: 利用印度央行2006年银行授权政策作为准自然实验，采用双重差分方法分析政策效果。
AI.findings: 私人银行在欠发达地区扩张16.3%，公共银行无系统性扩张；私人银行贷款使高MRPK企业的资本边际收益降低约60%，缓解了资本错配。
AI.theory_contributions: 为混合所有制银行环境下的金融改革效果提供了理论证据，深化了对银行所有制与资本配置关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明金融改革在发展中国家能够有效缓解资本错配，为政策制定者提供了改革依据。

title: How Does Sustainable Public Procurement Go From Policy To Practice? An Integrative Review
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Erasmus University Rotterdam - Department of Public Administration, KU Leuven - Department of Political Science

detail.title: How Does Sustainable Public Procurement Go From Policy To Practice? An Integrative Review
detail.abstract: It is unclear how sustainable public procurement goes from policy to practice. Sustainable public procurement is a regulatory approach to government contracting that covers a broad array of public interest goals and relies on repeated agreement about the interpretation and application of regulation. Building on the recently developed theory of agreement-based regulation, the integrative review screened 1901 sources and synthesized 86 studies based on a preregistered coding scheme. Sustainable public procurement goes from policy to practice by translating regulation into regulation-related contract terms and by valuating those terms with regards to specific goods, services and works. Translation and valuation rely on buyer capacity, sector capacity, and the intermediation of experts in multi-level governance processes. This integrative review contributes a synthesis on sustainable public procurement as a regulatory approach, and deepens the theoretical notion of agreement-based regulation.

AI.tldr: 可持续公共采购从政策到实践的转化机制：通过将法规转化为合同条款并对其进行价值评估，依赖于采购方能力、行业能力以及多级治理中专家中介作用
AI.research_question: 可持续公共采购如何从政策走向实践？
AI.motivation: 可持续公共采购作为政府合同监管方法，涵盖广泛的公共利益目标，依赖于对法规解释和应用的一致同意，但其从政策到实践的具体转化机制尚不明确
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于最近发展的基于同意的监管理论
AI.method: 整合性综述：筛选1901个来源，基于预注册编码方案综合86项研究
AI.findings: 可持续公共采购通过将法规转化为合同条款并对特定商品、服务和工程进行价值评估来实现从政策到实践的转化，这一过程依赖于采购方能力、行业能力以及多级治理中专家中介作用
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了基于同意的监管理论概念
AI.practical_contributions: 为可持续公共采购作为监管方法提供了综合框架

title: Information Acquisition in Financial Markets: When Liquidity Demand Matters
affiliations: Hunan University - School of Finance and Statistics and Hunan University

detail.title: Information Acquisition in Financial Markets: When Liquidity Demand Matters
detail.abstract: This paper examines the effects of acquiring non-fundamental information, particularly information related to liquidity demand, on financial markets. Our findings indicate that when fundamental information is exogenous, learning about such non-fundamental information enhances market quality through a price feedback mechanism. Conversely, when fundamental information is endogenous, it typically reduces market quality through a crowding-out effect, decreases total trading volume, but improves overall welfare. Further analysis reveals two critical insights: (i) fundamental and non-fundamental information exhibit strategic substitutability, and (ii) different sources of non-fundamental information demonstrate strategic complementarity. This study provides valuable insights into the interactions between different types of information and their implications for market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了获取非基本面信息（特别是流动性需求信息）对金融市场的影响。研究发现：当基本面信息外生时，学习非基本面信息通过价格反馈机制提升市场质量；当基本面信息内生时，则会通过挤出效应降低市场质量、减少总交易量，但提高整体福利。关键发现包括：基本面与非基本面信息具有战略替代性，不同来源的非基本面信息具有战略互补性。
AI.research_question: 获取非基本面信息（特别是流动性需求信息）对金融市场有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解不同类型信息（基本面与非基本面）在金融市场中的相互作用及其对市场动态的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学、市场微观结构理论、战略互动理论
AI.method: 理论模型分析，考察基本面信息外生与内生两种情况下的市场均衡
AI.findings:
1. 基本面信息外生时：学习非基本面信息通过价格反馈机制提升市场质量
2. 基本面信息内生时：学习非基本面信息通过挤出效应降低市场质量、减少交易量，但提高福利
3. 基本面与非基本面信息具有战略替代性
4. 不同来源的非基本面信息具有战略互补性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了基本面与非基本面信息之间的战略替代关系
2. 发现了不同非基本面信息源之间的战略互补性
3. 建立了信息类型与市场质量关系的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者信息获取策略提供指导
2. 为市场监管者理解信息对市场质量的影响提供理论依据
3. 有助于金融机构优化信息资源配置

title: Can collective action make resistant grapevine varieties sparkle in Champagne? A discrete choice experiment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Can collective action make resistant grapevine varieties sparkle in Champagne? A discrete choice experiment
detail.abstract: Fungus-resistant grapevine (FRG) varieties can significantly reduce fungicide use in winegrowing, yet their adoption remains limited. This study investigates how collective approaches can facilitate their adoption in Champagne, a leverage so far unexplored in the literature. Using a choice experiment, we evaluate collective options including shared technical support and resource pooling. Results show that winegrowers are more likely to plant FRGs with pre-planting support, whether collectively or individually. Autonomy is preferred once FRGs are planted. Pooling resources is preferred only by those who believe in economic efficiency through cooperation. Findings highlight the role of advisory services in providing support before and after planting FRGs. We also recommend that local stakeholders actively disseminate information on the costs and benefits of FRGs and communicate about the benefits of collective action.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在香槟地区通过集体方式促进抗真菌葡萄品种（FRG）的采用。通过选择实验发现，种植前支持（无论是集体还是个人形式）能显著提高种植意愿，而种植后种植者更偏好自主管理。资源整合仅对相信合作能带来经济效益的种植者有吸引力。研究强调了咨询服务在FRG种植前后的重要作用。
AI.research_question: 集体方法如何促进香槟地区抗真菌葡萄品种（FRG）的采用？
AI.motivation: 抗真菌葡萄品种能显著减少葡萄种植中的杀菌剂使用，但其采用仍然有限。现有文献尚未探索集体方法在促进FRG采用方面的潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于集体行动理论和农业技术创新采纳理论，探讨集体支持机制对FRG采纳的影响。
AI.method: 采用选择实验方法，评估包括共享技术支持和资源整合在内的集体选项。
AI.findings: 1. 种植前支持（集体或个人形式）能提高FRG种植意愿；2. 种植后种植者更偏好自主管理；3. 资源整合仅对相信合作经济效益的种植者有吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将集体行动理论应用于FRG采纳研究，揭示了不同采纳阶段对集体支持形式的偏好差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为咨询服务提供了具体指导：种植前提供支持，种植后尊重自主性；建议当地利益相关者积极传播FRG的成本效益信息，并宣传集体行动的好处。
